More than 1.05 crore voters were eligible to exercise their franchise at 11,905 polling stations. Counting of votes started immediately after the polling ended. Results are expected to be declared by late night. The declaration of results will bring the election of representatives in all 14,403 panchayats in the State to a close.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The sarpanch and ward panch polls are not contested on political party symbols and parties do not officially allot tickets for these posts, unlike the zila parishad and panchayat samiti polls. Polling for zila parishad and panchayat samiti members across all four phases has been completed. Votes will be counted on November 20.

articles.title: BJP holds key party meeting in Mathura for Assembly polls
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The party announced the meeting to discuss organisational programmes, booth empowerment, and public welfare benefits, while also outlining electoral strategy and caste-based outreach

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Senior BJP leaders from Uttar Pradesh, including Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath, attended a key meeting at the Pandit Deendayal Upadhyaya Cow Research Institute in Parkham, Mathura, to discuss strategy for the upcoming U.P. Assembly polls. The party announced the meeting to discuss organisational programmes, booth empowerment, and public welfare benefits, while also outlining electoral strategy and caste-based outreach to counter the Opposition’s renewed pitch. “One goal, one idea... BJP government again for the third time... Today, in Mathura, the birthplace of Lord Krishna, I participated in a planning meeting with National General Secretary (Organisation) B.L. Santosh, Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath, and BJP Uttar Pradesh Incharge Shri Vinod Tawde,” wrote Pankaj Chaudhary, U.P. BJP president, on X. “In the meeting, various important topics, including upcoming organisational programmes, booth empowerment, and providing benefits of public welfare schemes to every household, were discussed in detail. On this occasion, National General Secretary Irani, Deputy Chief Ministers Shri Keshav Prasad Maurya ji and Shri Brajesh Pathak, co-incharges of BJP Uttar Pradesh, Ministers of the State Government, public representatives, and state officials were present,” he added. State Deputy CM Keshav Prasad Maurya said the construction of a grand temple at Shri Krishna Janmabhoomi in Mathura will be a major poll issue in the 2027 U.P. elections, and that a grand Krishna temple will be built—through the courts or mutual dialogue, as with Ayodhya. “If Akhilesh Yadav wants to join us in kar seva, we will take him along too to build a grand temple of Lord Krishna,” said the Deputy CM. The meeting in Mathura is also significant amid the BJP’s emphasis on Mathura and western Uttar Pradesh. “The BJP holds meetings regularly to discuss organisational programmes, booth empowerment and other issues. Reach out to various sections of society is also part of our work,” said Dinesh Dubey, a senior BJP leader based in Lucknow. Asad Rizvi, a political analyst based in Lucknow, said, “the meeting is significant as it is organised only a few months before the Assembly elections. Amid the main Opposition parties (the Samajwadi Party-Congress) pushing backwards, Scheduled Castes (SCs), Brahmins and marginalised groups through the PDA plank, the BJP will be recalibrating their policies and making a renewed effort towards them. ”

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The SP president Akhilesh Yadav in a cryptic statement urged the BJP leaders to take a dip in the Yamuna and sip its water before starting the event. “I request them to take a dip in the Yamuna and sip its water before starting the event. It will be auspicious. If they fall ill, call a good doctor,” said Mr. Yadav.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #11 of 30 (17 NOV)

📰 BJP holds key party meeting in Mathura for Assembly polls

📌 Published: 17 Nov 2026, 04:57:22 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The party announced the meeting to discuss organisational programmes, booth empowerment, and public welfare benefits, while also outlining electoral strategy and caste-based outreach

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Senior BJP leaders from Uttar Pradesh, including Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath, attended a key meeting at the Pandit Deendayal Upadhyaya Cow Research Institute in Parkham, Mathura, to discuss strategy for the upcoming U.P. Assembly polls. The party announced the meeting to discuss organisational programmes, booth empowerment, and public welfare benefits, while also outlining electoral strategy and caste-based outreach to counter the Opposition’s renewed pitch. “One goal, one idea... BJP government again for the third time... Today, in Mathura, the birthplace of Lord Krishna, I participated in a planning meeting with National General Secretary (Organisation) B.L. Santosh, Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath, and BJP Uttar Pradesh Incharge Shri Vinod Tawde,” wrote Pankaj Chaudhary, U.P. BJP president, on X. “In the meeting, various important topics, including upcoming organisational programmes, booth empowerment, and providing benefits of public welfare schemes to every household, were discussed in detail. On this occasion, National General Secretary Irani, Deputy Chief Ministers Shri Keshav Prasad Maurya ji and Shri Brajesh Pathak, co-incharges of BJP Uttar Pradesh, Ministers of the State Government, public representatives, and state officials were present,” he added. State Deputy CM Keshav Prasad Maurya said the construction of a grand temple at Shri Krishna Janmabhoomi in Mathura will be a major poll issue in the 2027 U.P. elections, and that a grand Krishna temple will be built—through the courts or mutual dialogue, as with Ayodhya. “If Akhilesh Yadav wants to join us in kar seva, we will take him along too to build a grand temple of Lord Krishna,” said the Deputy CM. The meeting in Mathura is also significant amid the BJP’s emphasis on Mathura and western Uttar Pradesh. “The BJP holds meetings regularly to discuss organisational programmes, booth empowerment and other issues. Reach out to various sections of society is also part of our work,” said Dinesh Dubey, a senior BJP leader based in Lucknow. Asad Rizvi, a political analyst based in Lucknow, said, “the meeting is significant as it is organised only a few months before the Assembly elections. Amid the main Opposition parties (the Samajwadi Party-Congress) pushing backwards, Scheduled Castes (SCs), Brahmins and marginalised groups through the PDA plank, the BJP will be recalibrating their policies and making a renewed effort towards them. ”

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The SP president Akhilesh Yadav in a cryptic statement urged the BJP leaders to take a dip in the Yamuna and sip its water before starting the event. “I request them to take a dip in the Yamuna and sip its water before starting the event. It will be auspicious. If they fall ill, call a good doctor,” said Mr. Yadav.

articles.title: Tribute to Kartar Singh Sarabha, Punjab free from drugs and unemployment, says CM Mann
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The Chief Minister said his government is working to build the progressive Punjab they envision

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann said on Monday (November 16, 2026) that the greatest tribute to the 19-year-old revolutionary and freedom fighter Kartar Singh Sarabha is to fulfil his dream of a Punjab free from drugs, unemployment, and injustice. He was speaking after paying tribute to Shaheed Kartar Singh Sarabha on his 111th martyrdom anniversary at his native village, Sarabha, in Ludhiana district. The Chief Minister said his government is working to build the progressive Punjab they envision. “Shaheed Kartar Singh Sarabha embraced the gallows at the tender age of just 19, proving that courage, conviction and love for the motherland know no age. At a time when youngsters today are planning their futures, this great revolutionary was planning the liberation of the country. He sacrificed his youth, dreams and ultimately his life for our freedom,” he said. “On November 16, 1915, Shaheed Kartar Singh Sarabha was hanged at Lahore Central Jail along with six other revolutionaries in the First Lahore Conspiracy Case. His fearless commitment to the freedom of the country remains a shining example of patriotism and selflessness,” he added. As the Punjab 2027 Assembly election approaches, the drug menace has once again become a central campaign issue. In the run-up to the Assembly polls, the major political parties in the fray—the Congress, the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP), the Shiromani Akali Dal (SAD), and the ruling Aam Aadmi Party (AAP)—are making the drug menace a key plank of their campaigns.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: While the ruling party has been asserting that eradicating drugs is its “biggest priority,” the Opposition parties have accused the AAP of failing to curb the drug menace and instead patronising the drug trade.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #12 of 30 (17 NOV)

📰 Tribute to Kartar Singh Sarabha, Punjab free from drugs and unemployment, says CM Mann

📌 Published: 17 Nov 2026, 04:27:18 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The Chief Minister said his government is working to build the progressive Punjab they envision

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann said on Monday (November 16, 2026) that the greatest tribute to the 19-year-old revolutionary and freedom fighter Kartar Singh Sarabha is to fulfil his dream of a Punjab free from drugs, unemployment, and injustice. He was speaking after paying tribute to Shaheed Kartar Singh Sarabha on his 111th martyrdom anniversary at his native village, Sarabha, in Ludhiana district. The Chief Minister said his government is working to build the progressive Punjab they envision. “Shaheed Kartar Singh Sarabha embraced the gallows at the tender age of just 19, proving that courage, conviction and love for the motherland know no age. At a time when youngsters today are planning their futures, this great revolutionary was planning the liberation of the country. He sacrificed his youth, dreams and ultimately his life for our freedom,” he said. “On November 16, 1915, Shaheed Kartar Singh Sarabha was hanged at Lahore Central Jail along with six other revolutionaries in the First Lahore Conspiracy Case. His fearless commitment to the freedom of the country remains a shining example of patriotism and selflessness,” he added. As the Punjab 2027 Assembly election approaches, the drug menace has once again become a central campaign issue. In the run-up to the Assembly polls, the major political parties in the fray—the Congress, the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP), the Shiromani Akali Dal (SAD), and the ruling Aam Aadmi Party (AAP)—are making the drug menace a key plank of their campaigns.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: While the ruling party has been asserting that eradicating drugs is its “biggest priority,” the Opposition parties have accused the AAP of failing to curb the drug menace and instead patronising the drug trade.

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Tribute to Kartar Singh Sarabha, Punjab free from drugs and unemployment, says CM Mann", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. The Chief Minister said his government is working to build the progressive Punjab they envision.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Tribute to Kartar Singh Sarabha, Punjab free fro' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.

articles.title: Kishtwar killings aftermath: Remarks by Congress’ Karra, BJP’s Parihar spark protests in J&K
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Mr. Karra said that “two SPOs were killed by the Army in a mistaken-identity case on November 11”, while senior BJP leader Sharma said, “Congress is spreading misleading information to shift blame from terrorists to security forces”

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Two separate remarks made by J&K Pradesh Congress Committee (JKPCC) president Tariq Hameed Karra and BJP legislator Shagun Parihar in the aftermath of the killing of two Special Police Officers (SPOs) in Kishtwar on Monday (November 16, 2026) sparked protests from different quarters. In response to the statement by Mr. Karra that “two SPOs were killed reportedly by the Army in a mistaken identity case on November 11”, senior BJP leader and Leader of Opposition (LoP) Sunil Sharma said, “The Congress is spreading misleading information to shift the blame from terrorists to our security forces. The SPOs were on duty and travelling to an Army post at Dharna-Marwah to relieve the jawans posted there. Calling two martyrs hunters is an insult to their sacrifice and to their grieving families.” He demanded that Mr. Karra “immediately withdraw the remarks and apologise to the martyrs’ families, the J&K Police and the Indian Army”. Scores of members of the BJP and BJP-affiliated organisations held street protests against Mr. Karra and the Congress in Jammu. Members of the Bharatiya Janata Yuva Morcha (BJYM) also burn an effigy of Mr. Karra as a mark of protest. BJYM leader Arun Prabhat, while condemning the statement of Mr. Karra, said, “It shows the hearts of Congress beat for Pakistan. The conspirators should face action. In case of any role of mosques, such places too should face action.” Mr. Prabhat was seconding the controversial remarks of Ms. Parihar of the BJP, who claimed “announcements were made from the mosques in Kishtwar’s Dachhan area to identify the targets” allegedly ahead of the killings of two SPOs on November 11. However, several religious organisations, including the Anjuman Islamia Bhaderwah and Kishtwar, in the Chenab Valley condemned the statement of Ms. Parihar and denied any role of mosques in the latest attack on the policemen. Ruling National Conference (NC) legislator Tanvir Sadiq said the BJP must be “held accountable for its MLA’s deeply irresponsible and inflammatory allegations against a mosque in Jammu”. “Making communal allegations in the aftermath of a tragic killing is utterly unacceptable. The BJP leadership cannot hide behind silence or pretend this is an isolated matter. It must unequivocally condemn these remarks and issue an unconditional public apology. Stop playing with the communal harmony of J&K,” said Mr. Sadiq. A spokesman of the All J&K Shia Association said the organisation “strongly condemn Ms. Parihar’s attempt to drag a mosque into the tragic killing of our brave SPOs”. “Terrorists are enemies of all humanity and terrorism has no religion. Unsubstantiated claims against a place of worship only weaken our fight against terror,” said the Association.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Jammu and Kashmir / Indian National Congress / Bharatiya Janata Party

However, several religious organisations, including the Anjuman Islamia Bhaderwah and Kishtwar, in the Chenab Valley condemned the statement of Ms. Parihar and denied any role of mosques in the latest attack on the policemen. Ruling National Conference (NC) legislator Tanvir Sadiq said the BJP must be “held accountable for its MLA’s deeply irresponsible and inflammatory allegations against a mosque in Jammu”. “Making communal allegations in the aftermath of a tragic killing is utterly unacceptable. A spokesman of the All J&K Shia Association said the organisation “strongly condemn Ms. Parihar’s attempt to drag a mosque into the tragic killing of our brave SPOs”. “Terrorists are enemies of all humanity and terrorism has no religion. Unsubstantiated claims against a place of worship only weaken our fight against terror,” said the Association.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #9 of 30 (17 NOV)

📰 Kishtwar killings aftermath: Remarks by Congress’ Karra, BJP’s Parihar spark protests in J&K

📌 Published: 17 Nov 2026, 03:36:43 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Mr. Karra said that “two SPOs were killed by the Army in a mistaken-identity case on November 11”, while senior BJP leader Sharma said, “Congress is spreading misleading information to shift blame from terrorists to security forces”

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Two separate remarks made by J&K Pradesh Congress Committee (JKPCC) president Tariq Hameed Karra and BJP legislator Shagun Parihar in the aftermath of the killing of two Special Police Officers (SPOs) in Kishtwar on Monday (November 16, 2026) sparked protests from different quarters. In response to the statement by Mr. Karra that “two SPOs were killed reportedly by the Army in a mistaken identity case on November 11”, senior BJP leader and Leader of Opposition (LoP) Sunil Sharma said, “The Congress is spreading misleading information to shift the blame from terrorists to our security forces. The SPOs were on duty and travelling to an Army post at Dharna-Marwah to relieve the jawans posted there. Calling two martyrs hunters is an insult to their sacrifice and to their grieving families.” He demanded that Mr. Karra “immediately withdraw the remarks and apologise to the martyrs’ families, the J&K Police and the Indian Army”. Scores of members of the BJP and BJP-affiliated organisations held street protests against Mr. Karra and the Congress in Jammu. Members of the Bharatiya Janata Yuva Morcha (BJYM) also burn an effigy of Mr. Karra as a mark of protest. BJYM leader Arun Prabhat, while condemning the statement of Mr. Karra, said, “It shows the hearts of Congress beat for Pakistan. The conspirators should face action. In case of any role of mosques, such places too should face action.” Mr. Prabhat was seconding the controversial remarks of Ms. Parihar of the BJP, who claimed “announcements were made from the mosques in Kishtwar’s Dachhan area to identify the targets” allegedly ahead of the killings of two SPOs on November 11. However, several religious organisations, including the Anjuman Islamia Bhaderwah and Kishtwar, in the Chenab Valley condemned the statement of Ms. Parihar and denied any role of mosques in the latest attack on the policemen. Ruling National Conference (NC) legislator Tanvir Sadiq said the BJP must be “held accountable for its MLA’s deeply irresponsible and inflammatory allegations against a mosque in Jammu”. “Making communal allegations in the aftermath of a tragic killing is utterly unacceptable. The BJP leadership cannot hide behind silence or pretend this is an isolated matter. It must unequivocally condemn these remarks and issue an unconditional public apology. Stop playing with the communal harmony of J&K,” said Mr. Sadiq. A spokesman of the All J&K Shia Association said the organisation “strongly condemn Ms. Parihar’s attempt to drag a mosque into the tragic killing of our brave SPOs”. “Terrorists are enemies of all humanity and terrorism has no religion. Unsubstantiated claims against a place of worship only weaken our fight against terror,” said the Association.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Jammu and Kashmir / Indian National Congress / Bharatiya Janata Party

A. Karra said that “two SPOs were killed by the Army in a mistaken-identity case on November 11”, while senior BJP leader Sharma said, “Congress is...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Kishtwar killings aftermath: Remarks by Congress' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Kishtwar killings aftermath: Remarks by Congr' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Kishtwar killings aftermath: Remarks by Congr' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Karra said that “two SPOs were killed by the Army in a mistaken-identity case on November 11”, while senior BJP leader Sharma said, “Congress is..." (Hinglish Arth: कर्रा ने कहा कि “11 नवंबर को गलत पहचान के मामले में सेना ने दो एसपीओ को मार डाला”, जबकि वरिष्ठ भाजपा नेता शर्मा ने कहा, “कांग्रेस आतंकवादियों से सुरक्षा पर दोष मढ़ने के लिए भ्रामक जानकारी फैला रही है।”)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Kishtwar killings aftermath: Remarks by Congress’ Karra, BJP’s Parihar spark protests in J&K"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. Jammu and Kashmir / Indian National Congress / Bharatiya Janata Party.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Jammu and Kashmir / Indian National Congress / Bharatiya Janata Party." (Hinglish Arth: जम्मू और कश्मीर / भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस / भारतीय जनता पार्टी)

articles.title: Customers at some of the U.S.’ largest banks are reporting difficulty accessing accounts online
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Bank of America, Chase, J.P. Morgan, U.S. Bank, Wells Fargo and Zelle were listed by users as down or experiencing issues, according to the website downdetector.com

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Customers reported difficulty accessing the online accounts at some of the U.S.’ largest banks on Monday (November 16, 2026). Bank of America, Chase, J.P. Morgan, U.S. Bank, Wells Fargo and Zelle were listed by users as down or experiencing issues, according to the website downdetector.com. Chase Bank’s services are experiencing a technical bug issue, not a cyber issue, a spokesperson said Monday (November 16, 2026). “Due to a technical issue, some transactions are taking longer than usual to complete but customers still have access to their accounts and funds,” a Chase spokesperson said in a statement. “We are working to resolve this as quickly as possible.” The reports follow a major outage by Microsoft that began on Friday (November 13, 2026) and lasted for hours, which impacted services including Outlook, Teams and the AI assistant Copilot.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Some Chase customers received a message that said, “Some services aren’t available. We’re working on them. Please try back later.”

articles.title: Cyclone Akvan brews over Bay of Bengal: What you need to know
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Cyclone Akvan may intensify into a Severe Cyclonic Storm over westcentral Bay of Bengal by Tuesday (November 17, 2026)

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A weather system brewing over the Bay of Bengal has intensified into a severe cyclonic storm on Monday evening (November 16, 2026), according to the Indian Meteorological Department (IMD). It is moving north-northwestwards towards Andhra Pradesh at 10 kmph and has been named ‘Akvan’, a name suggested by Iran under the North Indian Ocean naming list. CS Akvan over central adj westcentral BoB at 0530IST 17 Nov 610km E of Chennai 630km NE of Trincomalee 660km SE of Machilipatnam 670km SSE of Visakhapatnam 790km S of Gopalpur. Likely SCS today VSCS on 19th. Crossing AP coast as VSCS on 20th Nov. https://t.co/Qc2SeQNUPU It originated as a well-marked low-pressure area over the southeast Bay of Bengal on Saturday (November 14, 2026), the system intensified into a depression by Sunday (November 15, 2026) morning. The storm may continue to move north-northwestwards and intensify into a Severe Cyclonic Storm over westcentral Bay of Bengal by Tuesday (November 17, 2026) evening and may cross the A.P. coast around noon on November 20, as a Very Severe Cyclonic Storm, with windspeed gusting to 145 kmph, similar to that of Arnab. The system is forecast to bypass Tamil Nadu and move toward the Andhra Pradesh coast around November 19, 2026, also impacting Odisha. ALSO WATCH Odisha braces for possible third cyclone in three weeks as Bay of Bengal system intensifies Heavy rainfall warnings have been issued for coastal Andhra Pradesh, Odisha and Andaman and Nicobar Islands through November 20, 2026. In West Bengal, heavy rain is forecast for South 24 Parganas and Purba Medinipur from November 19 to 21, 2026, with downpour likely in the southern districts of Howrah, Paschim Medinipur and Jhargram on November 20 and 21. According to the IMD, thunderstorms, accompanied with winds up to 40 kmph in Kolkata and most districts of Gangetic West Bengal is also likely. A nip in the air over South Bengal is likely to dissipate as day and night temperatures will rise by two to three degrees Celsius from November 18, 2026, it said.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Cyclone Akvan is expected to cause rains in north coastal districts in Tamil Nadu, Puducherry and Karaikal area, it said.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #12 of 30 (17 NOV)

📰 Cyclone Akvan brews over Bay of Bengal: What you need to know

📌 Published: 17 Nov 2026, 10:50:55 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Cyclone Akvan may intensify into a Severe Cyclonic Storm over westcentral Bay of Bengal by Tuesday (November 17, 2026)

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A weather system brewing over the Bay of Bengal has intensified into a severe cyclonic storm on Monday evening (November 16, 2026), according to the Indian Meteorological Department (IMD). It is moving north-northwestwards towards Andhra Pradesh at 10 kmph and has been named ‘Akvan’, a name suggested by Iran under the North Indian Ocean naming list. CS Akvan over central adj westcentral BoB at 0530IST 17 Nov 610km E of Chennai 630km NE of Trincomalee 660km SE of Machilipatnam 670km SSE of Visakhapatnam 790km S of Gopalpur. Likely SCS today VSCS on 19th. Crossing AP coast as VSCS on 20th Nov. https://t.co/Qc2SeQNUPU It originated as a well-marked low-pressure area over the southeast Bay of Bengal on Saturday (November 14, 2026), the system intensified into a depression by Sunday (November 15, 2026) morning. The storm may continue to move north-northwestwards and intensify into a Severe Cyclonic Storm over westcentral Bay of Bengal by Tuesday (November 17, 2026) evening and may cross the A.P. coast around noon on November 20, as a Very Severe Cyclonic Storm, with windspeed gusting to 145 kmph, similar to that of Arnab. The system is forecast to bypass Tamil Nadu and move toward the Andhra Pradesh coast around November 19, 2026, also impacting Odisha. ALSO WATCH Odisha braces for possible third cyclone in three weeks as Bay of Bengal system intensifies Heavy rainfall warnings have been issued for coastal Andhra Pradesh, Odisha and Andaman and Nicobar Islands through November 20, 2026. In West Bengal, heavy rain is forecast for South 24 Parganas and Purba Medinipur from November 19 to 21, 2026, with downpour likely in the southern districts of Howrah, Paschim Medinipur and Jhargram on November 20 and 21. According to the IMD, thunderstorms, accompanied with winds up to 40 kmph in Kolkata and most districts of Gangetic West Bengal is also likely. A nip in the air over South Bengal is likely to dissipate as day and night temperatures will rise by two to three degrees Celsius from November 18, 2026, it said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Cyclone Akvan is expected to cause rains in north coastal districts in Tamil Nadu, Puducherry and Karaikal area, it said.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Meteorological (Adjective)
मौसम विज्ञान और वायुमंडलीय परिवर्तनों से संबंधित (Connected with weather forecasting and atmospheric shifts).
✓ Syn: Atmospheric, Climatic, Weather-related  |  ✖ Ant: Geological, Subterranean, Terrestrial
Westcentral (Adjective)
पश्चिम मध्य — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Westcentral' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Department (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Department' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Depression (Adjective / Verb)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Depression' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Cyclone Akvan brews over Bay of Bengal: What you need to know", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Cyclone Akvan may intensify into a Severe Cyclonic Storm over westcentral Bay of Bengal by Tuesday (November 17, 2026).
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Cyclone Akvan brews over Bay of Bengal: What you' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Cyclone Akvan brews over Bay of Bengal: What ' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Cyclone Akvan brews over Bay of Bengal: What ' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Cyclone Akvan may intensify into a Severe Cyclonic Storm over westcentral Bay of Bengal by Tuesday (November 17, 2026)." (Hinglish Arth: चक्रवात अकवन मंगलवार (17 नवंबर, 2026) तक पश्चिम मध्य बंगाल की खाड़ी के ऊपर एक गंभीर चक्रवाती तूफान में बदल सकता है।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Cyclone Akvan brews over Bay of Bengal: What you need to know"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. Cyclone Akvan is expected to cause rains in north coastal districts in Tamil Nadu, Puducherry and Karaikal area, it said.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Cyclone Akvan is expected to cause rains in north coastal districts in Tamil Nadu, Puducherry and Karaikal area, it said." (Hinglish Arth: इसमें कहा गया है कि चक्रवात अकवन से तमिलनाडु के उत्तरी तटीय जिलों, पुडुचेरी और कराईकल क्षेत्र में बारिश होने की उम्मीद है।)

articles.title: No proof from ECI to show SIR was a ‘unanimous’ decision, Rahul Gandhi to Supreme Court
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The ECI’s October 26 affidavit, in response to a petition filed by INDIA bloc leaders led by Mr. Gandhi, denied any differences of opinion between the CEC and the Election Commissioners over the SIR process

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Leader of the Opposition Rahul Gandhi told the Supreme Court on Monday (November 16, 2026) that the Election Commission of India (ECI) failed to produce any proof to establish its claim that the special intensive revision (SIR) was a “unanimous” decision made by Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar , and Election Commissioners Sukhbir Singh Sandhu and Vivek Joshi. “No minutes of the meeting, file notings, recorded approvals, agenda, deliberations or other primary material evidencing the participation and approval of all three members have been produced with the ECI counter-affidavit of October 26,” Mr. Gandhi submitted in his rejoinder. Mr. Gandhi and other INDIA bloc leaders have also separately filed an application containing a set of “interrogatories” directed at the CEC, the two Election Commissioners, and other senior ECI officials involved in the SIR. The pointed questions inquire about the number and details of each SIR file, as well as the specific occasions between February 19, 2025, and October 26, 2026, on which the two Election Commissioners objected in writing or expressed dissent or reservation regarding any matter related to the SIR, ECINET, Form 6, or the filing of appeals. The case is scheduled for hearing on November 17 before a Bench headed by Chief Justice of India Surya Kant. The reported friction between Mr. Kumar and the two Election Commissioners over the SIR and the CEC’s allegedly unilateral and authoritarian conduct, had triggered widespread protests across India demanding his removal from office. The ECI’s October 26 affidavit, in response to a petition filed by INDIA bloc leaders led by Mr. Gandhi, denied any differences of opinion between the CEC and the Election Commissioners over the SIR process. Mr. Gandhi said the court must not accept such “bare assertions” from the ECI. He questioned why the affidavit was filed by the ECI when Mr. Kumar, Mr. Sandhu and Mr. Joshi were separately made respondents. The Opposition leader, represented by senior advocate A.M. Singhvi and advocate Prasanna S., said the EC chose not to explain when and where exactly the decision to conduct a nationwide SIR was made. The ECI affidavit’s blank assertions contradict its own Right to Information (RTI) response that “the Commission has so far not taken any decision on initiating a special intensive revision (SIR) across the country in 2025”.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Mr. Gandhi said the ECI’s claim of a “unanimous” Commission did not quite agree with the fact that Mr. Sandhu and Mr. Joshi took the unprecedented step of writing directly to the Cabinet Secretary, conveying their displeasure over the conduct of affairs within the poll body during the SIR exercise.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #11 of 30 (17 NOV)

📰 No proof from ECI to show SIR was a ‘unanimous’ decision, Rahul Gandhi to Supreme Court

📌 Published: 17 Nov 2026, 06:43:16 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The ECI’s October 26 affidavit, in response to a petition filed by INDIA bloc leaders led by Mr. Gandhi, denied any differences of opinion between the CEC and the Election Commissioners over the SIR process

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Leader of the Opposition Rahul Gandhi told the Supreme Court on Monday (November 16, 2026) that the Election Commission of India (ECI) failed to produce any proof to establish its claim that the special intensive revision (SIR) was a “unanimous” decision made by Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar , and Election Commissioners Sukhbir Singh Sandhu and Vivek Joshi. “No minutes of the meeting, file notings, recorded approvals, agenda, deliberations or other primary material evidencing the participation and approval of all three members have been produced with the ECI counter-affidavit of October 26,” Mr. Gandhi submitted in his rejoinder. Mr. Gandhi and other INDIA bloc leaders have also separately filed an application containing a set of “interrogatories” directed at the CEC, the two Election Commissioners, and other senior ECI officials involved in the SIR. The pointed questions inquire about the number and details of each SIR file, as well as the specific occasions between February 19, 2025, and October 26, 2026, on which the two Election Commissioners objected in writing or expressed dissent or reservation regarding any matter related to the SIR, ECINET, Form 6, or the filing of appeals. The case is scheduled for hearing on November 17 before a Bench headed by Chief Justice of India Surya Kant. The reported friction between Mr. Kumar and the two Election Commissioners over the SIR and the CEC’s allegedly unilateral and authoritarian conduct, had triggered widespread protests across India demanding his removal from office. The ECI’s October 26 affidavit, in response to a petition filed by INDIA bloc leaders led by Mr. Gandhi, denied any differences of opinion between the CEC and the Election Commissioners over the SIR process. Mr. Gandhi said the court must not accept such “bare assertions” from the ECI. He questioned why the affidavit was filed by the ECI when Mr. Kumar, Mr. Sandhu and Mr. Joshi were separately made respondents. The Opposition leader, represented by senior advocate A.M. Singhvi and advocate Prasanna S., said the EC chose not to explain when and where exactly the decision to conduct a nationwide SIR was made. The ECI affidavit’s blank assertions contradict its own Right to Information (RTI) response that “the Commission has so far not taken any decision on initiating a special intensive revision (SIR) across the country in 2025”.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Mr. Gandhi said the ECI’s claim of a “unanimous” Commission did not quite agree with the fact that Mr. Sandhu and Mr. Joshi took the unprecedented step of writing directly to the Cabinet Secretary, conveying their displeasure over the conduct of affairs within the poll body during the SIR exercise.

articles.title: Six Liangmai Naga civilians laid to rest in Manipur 187 days after abduction, killing
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: United Naga Council president N.G. Lorho said May 13, 2026, would remain the darkest day in Manipur’s history

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The bodies of six Liangmai Naga civilians were laid to rest in Manipur’s Kangpokpi district on Monday (November 16, 2026), 187 days after they were abducted and subsequently killed almost a month later. The family of the deceased and Naga organisations had refused to claim the bodies — kept at the mortuary of the Jawaharlal Nehru Institute of Medical Sciences in Imphal since June 10 — until their demands were met. One of the main demands of the Naga civil bodies was the abrogation of the 2008 Suspension of Operations agreements with 25 Kuki-Zomi armed groups. The UNC and the families agreed to accept the bodies after receiving assurances of justice at a tripartite meeting involving the Union government, the Manipur government and Naga organisations in Guwahati on September 26, and after the completion of a safer alternative road for the people of Konsakhul village. The families received the bodies on Monday and transported them to their home village of Konsakhul in the Kuki-dominated Kangpokpi district for the final rites. People from various communities gathered for the funeral. Speaking at the funeral, United Naga Council (UNC) president N.G. Lorho said May 13, 2026, would remain the darkest day in Manipur’s history. “On that day, six Naga men were killed, mutilated, and dismembered at Leilon Vaiphei village by KNF-P (Kuki National Front-Presidential), Kuki militants, and Leilon villagers. Their bodies were treated in a manner that brings shame to the State of Manipur and to India before the whole world,” he said. He also noted that the funeral underscored the unity of the Nagas and other indigenous communities of Manipur. “Our land is being invaded and ravaged. Our people are being killed, displaced, and terrorised. If this incursion is not stopped, the very existence, identity, and future of the indigenous people of Manipur will be at stake,” Mr. Lorho said. The UNC, Manipur’s apex Naga organisation, urged the Centre to immediately end the “policy of appeasement and protection of militant groups” carrying out attacks and killings, and to fulfill its constitutional and moral responsibility to protect the lives, land, and identity of indigenous people.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The killing of three Thadou church leaders in an ambush in Kangpokpi district on May 13 prompted a series of abductions. The Thadous are divided over their Kuki identity.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #12 of 30 (17 NOV)

📰 Six Liangmai Naga civilians laid to rest in Manipur 187 days after abduction, killing

📌 Published: 17 Nov 2026, 06:42:45 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: United Naga Council president N.G. Lorho said May 13, 2026, would remain the darkest day in Manipur’s history

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The bodies of six Liangmai Naga civilians were laid to rest in Manipur’s Kangpokpi district on Monday (November 16, 2026), 187 days after they were abducted and subsequently killed almost a month later. The family of the deceased and Naga organisations had refused to claim the bodies — kept at the mortuary of the Jawaharlal Nehru Institute of Medical Sciences in Imphal since June 10 — until their demands were met. One of the main demands of the Naga civil bodies was the abrogation of the 2008 Suspension of Operations agreements with 25 Kuki-Zomi armed groups. The UNC and the families agreed to accept the bodies after receiving assurances of justice at a tripartite meeting involving the Union government, the Manipur government and Naga organisations in Guwahati on September 26, and after the completion of a safer alternative road for the people of Konsakhul village. The families received the bodies on Monday and transported them to their home village of Konsakhul in the Kuki-dominated Kangpokpi district for the final rites. People from various communities gathered for the funeral. Speaking at the funeral, United Naga Council (UNC) president N.G. Lorho said May 13, 2026, would remain the darkest day in Manipur’s history. “On that day, six Naga men were killed, mutilated, and dismembered at Leilon Vaiphei village by KNF-P (Kuki National Front-Presidential), Kuki militants, and Leilon villagers. Their bodies were treated in a manner that brings shame to the State of Manipur and to India before the whole world,” he said. He also noted that the funeral underscored the unity of the Nagas and other indigenous communities of Manipur. “Our land is being invaded and ravaged. Our people are being killed, displaced, and terrorised. If this incursion is not stopped, the very existence, identity, and future of the indigenous people of Manipur will be at stake,” Mr. Lorho said. The UNC, Manipur’s apex Naga organisation, urged the Centre to immediately end the “policy of appeasement and protection of militant groups” carrying out attacks and killings, and to fulfill its constitutional and moral responsibility to protect the lives, land, and identity of indigenous people.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The killing of three Thadou church leaders in an ambush in Kangpokpi district on May 13 prompted a series of abductions. The Thadous are divided over their Kuki identity.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Institutional (Adjective)
संस्थागत — देश की संवैधानिक या सरकारी संस्थाओं के नियमों और ढांचे से जुड़ा हुआ।
✓ Syn: Systemic, Organizational, Constitutional  |  ✖ Ant: Individual, Informal, Unorganized
Constitutional (Adjective)
संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप।
✓ Syn: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful  |  ✖ Ant: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary
Indigenous (Adjective)
स्वदेशी — अपने ही देश (भारत) के वैज्ञानिकों और इंजीनियरों द्वारा देश में विकसित किया गया।
✓ Syn: Domestic, Home-grown, Native  |  ✖ Ant: Imported, Foreign, Exotic
Responsibility (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Responsibility' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Six Liangmai Naga civilians laid to rest in Manipur 187 days after abduction, killing", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Lorho said May 13, 2026, would remain the darkest day in Manipur’s history.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Six Liangmai Naga civilians laid to rest in Mani' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Six Liangmai Naga civilians laid to rest in M' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Six Liangmai Naga civilians laid to rest in M' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Lorho said May 13, 2026, would remain the darkest day in Manipur’s history." (Hinglish Arth: लोरहो ने कहा कि 13 मई, 2026 मणिपुर के इतिहास का सबसे काला दिन रहेगा)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Six Liangmai Naga civilians laid to rest in Manipur 187 days after abduction, killing"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. The Thadous are divided over their Kuki identity.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "The Thadous are divided over their Kuki identity." (Hinglish Arth: थडौस अपनी कुकी पहचान को लेकर विभाजित हैं।)

articles.title: Bilkis Bano case: Supreme Court suspends sentence, grants bail to two convicts
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The order published on the court website reasoned that the two men had already been imprisoned for more than 17 years and one of them suffers a severe handicap

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Supreme Court has granted bail to two convicts undergoing life imprisonment for the gangrape of Bilkis Bano and the murder of her family, including a two-month-old infant, during the 2002 riots. Justices M. M. Sundresh and Prasanna B. Varale suspended the life sentences of Bipinchand Kanaiyalal Joshi and Pradip Ramanlal Modhiya on October 28. The short order, published recently on the court website, reasoned that the two men had already been imprisoned for more than 17 years and one of them suffers a severe handicap. Besides, the court said there were “issues to be decided in the appeal, both on fact and law”. Senior advocate Siddharth Luthra, for the appellants, argued that Modhiya had not been named in the FIR, and was only implicated in the crime after a substantial period of nearly three years. Joshi, who underwent leg surgery, was described as handicapped. "Additional Solicitor General Raja Thakre and counsels for Gujarat and Maharashtra, Swati Ghildayal and Aaditya Aniruddha Pande, objected to the plea for bail and suspension of sentence. They argued that the offence was very serious, and their conviction by the trial court was confirmed in the High Court. “Having heard the parties, it suffices to state that the appellants have been under incarceration for a period of more than 17 years, and also the fact remains that one of the appellants has a severe handicap. Certainly, there are issues to be decided in the appeal, both on fact and law. In view of the above and considering the issues involved in this appeal, we suspend the sentence and grant bail to the appellants on such terms and conditions as may be imposed by the trial court,” the Bench ordered. The interim order was passed in an appeal filed by the two men against a May 2017 judgment of the Bombay High Court upholding their life sentences. A CBI Special Judge in Greater Mumbai had convicted the 11 men and sentenced them to life imprisonment in January 2008. In 2024, the apex court quashed the order of en masse remission granted by the State of Gujarat in August 2022 to the 11 men. The case was transferred by the Supreme Court in August 2004 from Gujarat to Maharashtra after noting that Ms. Bano had been “coerced to live the life of a nomad and an orphan… the gruesome and horrific acts of violence have left an indelible imprint on her mind which will continue to torment and cripple her”.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: court / crime / India / crime, law and justice / sexual assault / riots

A CBI Special Judge in Greater Mumbai had convicted the 11 men and sentenced them to life imprisonment in January 2008. In 2024, the apex court quashed the order of en masse remission granted by the State of Gujarat in August 2022 to the 11 men. The case was transferred by the Supreme Court in August 2004 from Gujarat to Maharashtra after noting that Ms. Bano had been “coerced to live the life of a nomad and an orphan… the gruesome and horrific acts of violence have left an indelible imprint on her mind which will continue to torment and cripple her”.

📰 Bilkis Bano case: Supreme Court suspends sentence, grants bail to two convicts

📌 Published: 17 Nov 2026, 06:42:18 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The order published on the court website reasoned that the two men had already been imprisoned for more than 17 years and one of them suffers a severe handicap

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Supreme Court has granted bail to two convicts undergoing life imprisonment for the gangrape of Bilkis Bano and the murder of her family, including a two-month-old infant, during the 2002 riots. Justices M. M. Sundresh and Prasanna B. Varale suspended the life sentences of Bipinchand Kanaiyalal Joshi and Pradip Ramanlal Modhiya on October 28. articles.title: ‘ISKCON’, ‘Tantric’, ‘Gorak Nath’: 287 ‘other’ religions briefly listed on Census portal
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The drop-down menu under the ‘Others’ category in the question pertaining to the respondent’s religion had 287 options for those not choosing from among the six major religions in India. After The Hindu raised a query about the classification, the drop-down menu was removed from the portal.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Going by the government's initial classification of “other” religions in the self-enumeration portal for the Population Enumeration phase of Census 2027 , ‘ISKCON’, ‘Ramakrishna Paramahans’, ‘Sanatan’, ‘Shri Ram’, ‘Shri Krishna’, ‘Balmiki’, ‘Ramdev’, ‘Bishnoi’, ‘Sarna’, ‘Tantric’, ‘Yogi’, ‘Shia’, ‘Sunni’, ‘Methodist’, and ‘Pentecostal’, are among the religions practised in the country. While these were among 287 options given under the ‘Others’ category for the question pertaining to the respondent's religion in the self-enumeration portal that went live on Monday (November 16, 2026) for four poll-bound States, the drop-down menu with these options was removed later in the day after The Hindu raised a query with the Union Ministry of Home Affairs regarding the classification. Along the same lines as the previous Census exercises, there are seven main categories in the religion column: Hindu, Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, and Others. In a first, the 'Others' category had been expanded into at least 287 further options, many of which have previously been classified by the Indian government as sects within the six major religions or as respondents’ entries in the “other religions and persuasions” category in the 2001 and 2011 Censuses. The drop-down menu also had several options that had not been recorded before, such as ‘ISKCON’, ‘Ramakrishna Paramhans’, ‘Ramdev’, ‘Khalsa’, ‘Tirupati Balaji’, ‘Gorak Nath’, ‘Basaveshwara’, ‘Baldev’, ‘Devi Maa’, ‘Devi Bhakt’, and ‘Dev Samaj’, among others. After the removal of the drop-down menu, a representative of the Registrar General and Census Commissioner of India (RG&CCI) said that, apart from the six major religions, there is the ‘Others’ category in which the “respondent is free to write any other religion as in previous censuses.” The official also said that it was “incorrect to say the mentioned terms have been shown as other religions”. However, a government official told The Hindu that the list of options had been prepared as "predictive text entries" for the 'Other' religions category to help enumerators fill in the forms without “spelling variations and mistakes” when a respondent mentions any faith other than the six major ones. Giving an example, the official explained that if a respondent said they were a follower of ISKCON, the predictive text list would complete the entry without spelling variations or mistakes. How these appeared as options in a drop-down box is being inquired into, the official said. The self-enumeration portal (se.census.gov.in) went live on Monday (November 16, 2026) for the States of Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Goa, and Punjab, where elections are scheduled to be held in 2027. For the rest of the country, the portal will open in January 2027. A retired Census official told The Hindu that the options in the now-removed drop-down box were “strange”, particularly because there is no previous data to compare them with. The retired official also said that these entries appeared to be sects or movements within major religions. In 2001 and 2011, the tables on classified sects within major religions and respondents’ entries in the ‘other religions and persuasions’ category were tabulated later, after the enumeration was completed. Before the drop-down box under the other religions category was removed, a government official in Uttar Pradesh, who provided training to Census enumerators, said, “The instructions are to record religion from the six mentioned categories. If a respondent chooses the ‘Other’ category, they can pick from the specified drop-down box with more than 280 names, and if the preferred religion’s name is not there, they can enter the name and it will be recorded as is." There has been a sustained movement by tribal communities in Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh, Odisha, and West Bengal, calling for a separate religion column for Adivasi faiths, which they asserted was different from Hinduism.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The current Census, which has been delayed by six years with the last one having been conducted in 2011, is being referred to as the first digital Census. It is also the first to enumerate caste and the first to allow self-enumeration. The Office of the RG&CCI has decided to use an open column for caste enumeration despite demands and protests for a drop-down box of all castes. The government’s justification for using an open column was that there was no single available list of all castes, apart from the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes lists.

hinglishTracks.en: The drop-down menu also had several options that had not been recorded before, such as ‘ISKCON’, ‘Ramakrishna Paramhans’, ‘Ramdev’, ‘Khalsa’, ‘Tirupati Balaji’, ‘Gorak Nath’, ‘Basaveshwara’, ‘Baldev’, ‘Devi Maa’, ‘Devi Bhakt’, and ‘Dev Samaj’, among others.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — ड्रॉप-डाउन मेनू में कई विकल्प भी थे जो पहले दर्ज नहीं किए गए थे, जैसे 'इस्कॉन', 'रामकृष्ण परमहंस', 'रामदेव', 'खालसा', 'तिरुपति बालाजी', 'गोरक नाथ', 'बसवेश्वर', 'बलदेव', 'देवी मां', 'देवी भक्त' और 'देव समाज', और अन्य।।

hinglishTracks.en: After the removal of the drop-down menu, a representative of the Registrar General and Census Commissioner of India (RG&CCI) said that, apart from the six major religions, there is the ‘Others’ category in which the “respondent is free to write any other religion as in previous censuses.” The official also said that it was “incorrect to say the mentioned terms have been shown as other religions”.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — ड्रॉप-डाउन मेनू को हटाने के बाद, भारत के रजिस्ट्रार जनरल और जनगणना आयुक्त (आरजी एंड सीसीआई) के एक प्रतिनिधि ने कहा कि, छह प्रमुख धर्मों के अलावा, 'अन्य' श्रेणी है जिसमें "प्रतिवादी पिछले जनगणनाओं की तरह किसी भी अन्य धर्म को लिखने के लिए स्वतंत्र है।" अधिकारी ने यह भी कहा कि "यह कहना गलत है कि उल्लिखित शब्दों को अन्य धर्मों के रूप में दिखाया गया है"।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Representative' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Representative' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: However, a government official told The Hindu that the list of options had been prepared as "predictive text entries" for the 'Other' religions category to help enumerators fill in the forms without “spelling variations and mistakes” when a respondent mentions any faith other than the six major ones.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — हालाँकि, एक सरकारी अधिकारी ने द हिंदू को बताया कि विकल्पों की सूची 'अन्य' धर्म श्रेणी के लिए "भविष्य कहनेवाला पाठ प्रविष्टियों" के रूप में तैयार की गई थी, ताकि गणनाकर्ताओं को "वर्तनी भिन्नता और गलतियों" के बिना फॉर्म भरने में मदद मिल सके, जब कोई प्रतिवादी छह प्रमुख धर्मों के अलावा किसी अन्य धर्म का उल्लेख करता है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Predictably' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: जैसा पहले से अनुमान था — बिना किसी आश्चर्य के बिल्कुल पूर्वानुमान के मुताबिक होना। इसके Synonyms हैं: Foreseeably, Expectedly, Inevitably और Antonyms हैं: Unexpectedly, Surprisingly, Abruptly।

hinglishTracks.en: Giving an example, the official explained that if a respondent said they were a follower of ISKCON, the predictive text list would complete the entry without spelling variations or mistakes.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — एक उदाहरण देते हुए, अधिकारी ने समझाया कि यदि कोई उत्तरदाता कहता है कि वह इस्कॉन का अनुयायी है, तो पूर्वानुमानित पाठ सूची वर्तनी भिन्नता या गलतियों के बिना प्रविष्टि को पूरा कर देगी।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Predictably' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: जैसा पहले से अनुमान था — बिना किसी आश्चर्य के बिल्कुल पूर्वानुमान के मुताबिक होना। इसके Synonyms हैं: Foreseeably, Expectedly, Inevitably और Antonyms हैं: Unexpectedly, Surprisingly, Abruptly।

hinglishTracks.en: How these appeared as options in a drop-down box is being inquired into, the official said.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — अधिकारी ने कहा कि ड्रॉप-डाउन बॉक्स में ये विकल्प के रूप में कैसे दिखाई दिए, इसकी जांच की जा रही है।।

hinglishTracks.en: The self-enumeration portal (se.census.gov.in) went live on Monday (November 16, 2026) for the States of Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Goa, and Punjab, where elections are scheduled to be held in 2027.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — स्व-गणना पोर्टल (se.census.gov.in) उत्तर प्रदेश, उत्तराखंड, गोवा और पंजाब राज्यों के लिए सोमवार (16 नवंबर, 2026) को लाइव हो गया, जहां 2027 में चुनाव होने हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: For the rest of the country, the portal will open in January 2027.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — देश के बाकी हिस्सों के लिए पोर्टल जनवरी 2027 में खुलेगा।।

hinglishTracks.en: A retired Census official told The Hindu that the options in the now-removed drop-down box were “strange”, particularly because there is no previous data to compare them with.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — एक सेवानिवृत्त जनगणना अधिकारी ने द हिंदू को बताया कि अब हटाए गए ड्रॉप-डाउन बॉक्स में विकल्प "अजीब" थे, खासकर इसलिए क्योंकि उनकी तुलना करने के लिए कोई पिछला डेटा नहीं है।।

hinglishTracks.en: The retired official also said that these entries appeared to be sects or movements within major religions.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — सेवानिवृत्त अधिकारी ने यह भी कहा कि ये प्रविष्टियाँ प्रमुख धर्मों के भीतर संप्रदायों या आंदोलनों की प्रतीत होती हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: In 2001 and 2011, the tables on classified sects within major religions and respondents’ entries in the ‘other religions and persuasions’ category were tabulated later, after the enumeration was completed.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — 2001 और 2011 में, गणना पूरी होने के बाद, प्रमुख धर्मों के भीतर वर्गीकृत संप्रदायों और 'अन्य धर्मों और अनुनय' श्रेणी में उत्तरदाताओं की प्रविष्टियों की तालिकाएँ बाद में सारणीबद्ध की गईं।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Classification' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Classification' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: Before the drop-down box under the other religions category was removed, a government official in Uttar Pradesh, who provided training to Census enumerators, said, “The instructions are to record religion from the six mentioned categories.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — अन्य धर्मों की श्रेणी के तहत ड्रॉप-डाउन बॉक्स हटाए जाने से पहले, उत्तर प्रदेश के एक सरकारी अधिकारी, जिन्होंने जनगणना गणनाकर्ताओं को प्रशिक्षण प्रदान किया था, ने कहा, “निर्देश छह उल्लिखित श्रेणियों से धर्म को रिकॉर्ड करने के लिए हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: If a respondent chooses the ‘Other’ category, they can pick from the specified drop-down box with more than 280 names, and if the preferred religion’s name is not there, they can enter the name and it will be recorded as is."
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — यदि कोई उत्तरदाता 'अन्य' श्रेणी चुनता है, तो वे 280 से अधिक नामों वाले निर्दिष्ट ड्रॉप-डाउन बॉक्स से चुन सकते हैं, और यदि पसंदीदा धर्म का नाम नहीं है, तो वे नाम दर्ज कर सकते हैं और इसे वैसे ही दर्ज किया जाएगा।'।

hinglishTracks.en: There has been a sustained movement by tribal communities in Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh, Odisha, and West Bengal, calling for a separate religion column for Adivasi faiths, which they asserted was different from Hinduism.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — झारखंड, छत्तीसगढ़, ओडिशा और पश्चिम बंगाल में आदिवासी समुदायों द्वारा लगातार आंदोलन किया जा रहा है, जिसमें आदिवासी आस्थाओं के लिए एक अलग धर्म स्तंभ की मांग की गई है, जिसके बारे में उनका दावा है कि यह हिंदू धर्म से अलग है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Sustainability' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: सतत विकास — पर्यावरण और भविष्य की पीढ़ियों को नुकसान पहुँचाए बिना लंबे समय तक चलने वाला विकास। इसके Synonyms हैं: Viability, Eco-balance, Durability और Antonyms हैं: Depletion, Unsustainability, Destruction।

hinglishTracks.en: The current Census, which has been delayed by six years with the last one having been conducted in 2011, is being referred to as the first digital Census.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — वर्तमान जनगणना, जिसमें छह साल की देरी हुई है और आखिरी जनगणना 2011 में हुई थी, को पहली डिजिटल जनगणना कहा जा रहा है।।

hinglishTracks.en: It is also the first to enumerate caste and the first to allow self-enumeration.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — यह जाति की गणना करने वाला पहला और आत्म-गणना की अनुमति देने वाला भी पहला है।।

hinglishTracks.en: The Office of the RG&CCI has decided to use an open column for caste enumeration despite demands and protests for a drop-down box of all castes.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — आरजी एंड सीसीआई कार्यालय ने सभी जातियों के ड्रॉप-डाउन बॉक्स की मांग और विरोध के बावजूद जाति गणना के लिए एक खुले कॉलम का उपयोग करने का निर्णय लिया है।।

hinglishTracks.en: The government’s justification for using an open column was that there was no single available list of all castes, apart from the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes lists.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — खुले कॉलम का उपयोग करने के लिए सरकार का औचित्य यह था कि अनुसूचित जाति और अनुसूचित जनजाति की सूची के अलावा, सभी जातियों की एक भी उपलब्ध सूची नहीं थी।।

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #9 of 30 (17 NOV)

📰 ‘ISKCON’, ‘Tantric’, ‘Gorak Nath’: 287 ‘other’ religions briefly listed on Census portal

📌 Published: 17 Nov 2026, 08:38:16 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The drop-down menu under the ‘Others’ category in the question pertaining to the respondent’s religion had 287 options for those not choosing from among the six major religions in India. After The Hindu raised a query about the classification, the drop-down menu was removed from the portal.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Going by the government's initial classification of “other” religions in the self-enumeration portal for the Population Enumeration phase of Census 2027 , ‘ISKCON’, ‘Ramakrishna Paramahans’, ‘Sanatan’, ‘Shri Ram’, ‘Shri Krishna’, ‘Balmiki’, ‘Ramdev’, ‘Bishnoi’, ‘Sarna’, ‘Tantric’, ‘Yogi’, ‘Shia’, ‘Sunni’, ‘Methodist’, and ‘Pentecostal’, are among the religions practised in the country. While these were among 287 options given under the ‘Others’ category for the question pertaining to the respondent's religion in the self-enumeration portal that went live on Monday (November 16, 2026) for four poll-bound States, the drop-down menu with these options was removed later in the day after The Hindu raised a query with the Union Ministry of Home Affairs regarding the classification. Along the same lines as the previous Census exercises, there are seven main categories in the religion column: Hindu, Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, and Others. In a first, the 'Others' category had been expanded into at least 287 further options, many of which have previously been classified by the Indian government as sects within the six major religions or as respondents’ entries in the “other religions and persuasions” category in the 2001 and 2011 Censuses. The drop-down menu also had several options that had not been recorded before, such as ‘ISKCON’, ‘Ramakrishna Paramhans’, ‘Ramdev’, ‘Khalsa’, ‘Tirupati Balaji’, ‘Gorak Nath’, ‘Basaveshwara’, ‘Baldev’, ‘Devi Maa’, ‘Devi Bhakt’, and ‘Dev Samaj’, among others. After the removal of the drop-down menu, a representative of the Registrar General and Census Commissioner of India (RG&CCI) said that, apart from the six major religions, there is the ‘Others’ category in which the “respondent is free to write any other religion as in previous censuses.” The official also said that it was “incorrect to say the mentioned terms have been shown as other religions”. However, a government official told The Hindu that the list of options had been prepared as "predictive text entries" for the 'Other' religions category to help enumerators fill in the forms without “spelling variations and mistakes” when a respondent mentions any faith other than the six major ones. Giving an example, the official explained that if a respondent said they were a follower of ISKCON, the predictive text list would complete the entry without spelling variations or mistakes. How these appeared as options in a drop-down box is being inquired into, the official said. The self-enumeration portal (se.census.gov.in) went live on Monday (November 16, 2026) for the States of Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Goa, and Punjab, where elections are scheduled to be held in 2027. For the rest of the country, the portal will open in January 2027. A retired Census official told The Hindu that the options in the now-removed drop-down box were “strange”, particularly because there is no previous data to compare them with. The retired official also said that these entries appeared to be sects or movements within major religions. In 2001 and 2011, the tables on classified sects within major religions and respondents’ entries in the ‘other religions and persuasions’ category were tabulated later, after the enumeration was completed. Before the drop-down box under the other religions category was removed, a government official in Uttar Pradesh, who provided training to Census enumerators, said, “The instructions are to record religion from the six mentioned categories. If a respondent chooses the ‘Other’ category, they can pick from the specified drop-down box with more than 280 names, and if the preferred religion’s name is not there, they can enter the name and it will be recorded as is." There has been a sustained movement by tribal communities in Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh, Odisha, and West Bengal, calling for a separate religion column for Adivasi faiths, which they asserted was different from Hinduism.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The current Census, which has been delayed by six years with the last one having been conducted in 2011, is being referred to as the first digital Census. It is also the first to enumerate caste and the first to allow self-enumeration. The Office of the RG&CCI has decided to use an open column for caste enumeration despite demands and protests for a drop-down box of all castes. The government’s justification for using an open column was that there was no single available list of all castes, apart from the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes lists.

✓ Syn: Foreseeably, Expectedly, Inevitably  |  ✖ Ant: Unexpectedly, Surprisingly, Abruptly

articles.summary: 1. Core Context & Background: The drop-down menu under the ‘Others’ category in the question pertaining to the respondent’s religion had 287 options for those not choosing from among the six major religions in India. After The Hindu raised a query about the classification, the drop-down menu was removed from the portal.
articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: The drop-down menu under the ‘Others’ category in the question pertaining to the respondent’s religion had 287 options for those not choosing from among the six major religions in India. After The Hindu raised a query about the classification, the drop-down menu was removed from the portal.
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Going by the government's initial classification of “other” religions in the self-enumeration portal for the Population Enumeration phase of Census 2027 , ‘ISKCON’, ‘Ramakrishna Paramahans’, ‘Sanatan’, ‘Shri Ram’, ‘Shri Krishna’, ‘Balmiki’, ‘Ramdev’, ‘Bishnoi’, ‘Sarna’, ‘Tantric’, ‘Yogi’, ‘Shia’, ‘Sunni’, ‘Methodist’, and ‘Pentecostal’, are among the religions practised in the country. While these were among 287 options given under the ‘Others’ category for the question pertaining to the respondent's religion in the self-enumeration portal that went live on Monday (November 16, 2026) for four poll-bound States, the drop-down menu with these options was removed later in the day after The Hindu raised a query with the Union Ministry of Home Affairs regarding the classification. Along the same lines as the previous Census exercises, there are seven main categories in the religion column: Hindu, Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, and Others. In a first, the 'Others' category had been expanded into at least 287 further options, many of which have previously been classified by the Indian government as sects within the six major religions or as respondents’ entries in the “other religions and persuasions” category in the 2001 and 2011 Censuses. The drop-down menu also had several options that had not been recorded before, such as ‘ISKCON’, ‘Ramakrishna Paramhans’, ‘Ramdev’, ‘Khalsa’, ‘Tirupati Balaji’, ‘Gorak Nath’, ‘Basaveshwara’, ‘Baldev’, ‘Devi Maa’, ‘Devi Bhakt’, and ‘Dev Samaj’, among others. After the removal of the drop-down menu, a representative of the Registrar General and Census Commissioner of India (RG&CCI) said that, apart from the six major religions, there is the ‘Others’ category in which the “respondent is free to write any other religion as in previous censuses.” The official also said that it was “incorrect to say the mentioned terms have been shown as other religions”. However, a government official told The Hindu that the list of options had been prepared as "predictive text entries" for the 'Other' religions category to help enumerators fill in the forms without “spelling variations and mistakes” when a respondent mentions any faith other than the six major ones. Giving an example, the official explained that if a respondent said they were a follower of ISKCON, the predictive text list would complete the entry without spelling variations or mistakes. How these appeared as options in a drop-down box is being inquired into, the official said. The self-enumeration portal (se.census.gov.in) went live on Monday (November 16, 2026) for the States of Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Goa, and Punjab, where elections are scheduled to be held in 2027. For the rest of the country, the portal will open in January 2027. A retired Census official told The Hindu that the options in the now-removed drop-down box were “strange”, particularly because there is no previous data to compare them with. The retired official also said that these entries appeared to be sects or movements within major religions. In 2001 and 2011, the tables on classified sects within major religions and respondents’ entries in the ‘other religions and persuasions’ category were tabulated later, after the enumeration was completed. Before the drop-down box under the other religions category was removed, a government official in Uttar Pradesh, who provided training to Census enumerators, said, “The instructions are to record religion from the six mentioned categories. If a respondent chooses the ‘Other’ category, they can pick from the specified drop-down box with more than 280 names, and if the preferred religion’s name is not there, they can enter the name and it will be recorded as is." There has been a sustained movement by tribal communities in Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh, Odisha, and West Bengal, calling for a separate religion column for Adivasi faiths, which they asserted was different from Hinduism.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The current Census, which has been delayed by six years with the last one having been conducted in 2011, is being referred to as the first digital Census. It is also the first to enumerate caste and the first to allow self-enumeration. The Office of the RG&CCI has decided to use an open column for caste enumeration despite demands and protests for a drop-down box of all castes. The government’s justification for using an open column was that there was no single available list of all castes, apart from the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes lists.

articles.title: What to know about the online banking delays affecting major U.S. banks
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: A technical issue at JPMorgan Chase caused problems throughout the financial system on Monday (November 16, 2026), resulting in thousands of customers reporting difficulty accessing online accounts at several major U.S. banks and the money transfer service Zelle.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: JPMorgan Chase, the largest U.S. bank by total assets, said a software bug was affecting its internal hardware systems and causing transaction delays. The company was working to bring banking services back online. Some Chase customers received a message that said, "Some services aren't available. We're working on them. Please try back later." In a sense, yes. Customers at Bank of America, Citigroup and other banks trying to transact with Chase may have seen their transactions slow, even though those banks were not having issues with their services. "Other banks may have been impacted by slowness in transactions only to the extent that they were a party to a transaction with us," explained Joe Evangelisti, a spokesperson for Chase. Zelle was not directly affected by the Chase glitch. But customers at other banks may have experienced transaction delays while trying to send or receive Zelle payments involving a Chase customer. Zelle is a rapid peer-to-peer payment system used by major US banks. The platform is owned by Arizona-based Early Warning Services, which in turn is owned by financial institutions including Bank of America, Capital One, JPMorgan Chase, PNC Bank, Truist, US Bank and Wells Fargo. A spokesperson for Early Warning Services said the Zelle network was fully operational. Chase said that the technical problem was not the result of a cyberattack, stressing that it was an isolated incident and not related to anything other than a bug.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Chase said its customers still have access to their accounts and funds. The company expects the issue to be resolved by the end of day Monday.
