articles.title: Nearly 75 lakh names added in draft SSR voters lists in 13 States and UTs
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: These States/UTs saw their combined electorate shrink from 49.6 cr to 45.2 cr post-SIR, but SSR has resulted in a recovery to almost 46 cr in draft SSR list; U.P. has highest number of voters added through SSR, but Goa sees highest growth in percentage terms

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Months after final voters lists were published following the contentious special intensive revision (SIR) of electoral rolls, nearly 75 lakh more names have been added in draft voter lists published in 13 States and Union Territories via a special summary revision process (SSR). The combined size of the electorate in these States before the SIR was 49.61 crore, which shrunk to 45.22 crore after the SIR and has now increased to 45.96 crore in the draft SSR list. This means there has been a cumulative increase of 1.64 %. Uttar Pradesh, which published its draft SSR list on Tuesday (November 17, 2026), saw 18.84 lakh names being added to its voter lists, the largest in absolute numbers so far. Goa saw the highest rate of additions, at 3.01 %. Bihar, which was the first State to undergo the SIR process in 2025 saw 13.89 lakh names being added to the final post-SIR list. Rajasthan saw more than 11.48 lakh voters being added to the final SIR voter list, followed by Uttarakhand (1.19 lakh), Madhya Pradesh (8.9 lakh), and Tamil Nadu (10.39 lakh). The SSR, on hold since the SIR process began last year, was first announced in 17 States and UTs, including poll-bound Uttarakhand, Uttar Pradesh, and Punjab, on October 15. On November 5, it was expanded to six more States where the SIR process is over, and on November 16, it was announced that the SSR would also be conducted in Karnataka and Meghalaya. Of these, the draft SSR rolls have been published for 15 States and UTs. The data for Punjab and Gujarat, however, was not available. The SSR, an annual exercise, usually seeks to enrol eligible voters, particularly young and first-time electors, and facilitate advance applications from those who will become eligible on April 1, July 1, and October 1, 2027. However, it had not been carried out after the SIR was launched last year, an anomaly that was recently highlighted by Election Commissioners S.S. Sandhu and Vivek Joshi. Unlike the now contentious SIR process, when enrolling through the SSR, voters do not need to provide any documentation proving citizenship or be mapped with earlier electoral rolls. Among the firsts, in this year’s SSR, the ECI has directed that, at the time of the polls, a “readable PDF” of the alphabetically arranged electoral rolls can be provided to the contesting candidates in a pen drive or any other electronic storage device. This is crucial as Opposition parties have been demanding machine-readable electoral rolls rather than image-based PDFs, so that they are digitally searchable, indexable, and verifiable. Political parties will also be provided with supplementary voter lists which were earlier kept only for records and future use.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The SSR process this time not only features the usual house-to-house visits by Booth Level Officers, but also includes the publication and display of draft as well as final voter lists at the polling booths.

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — एसआईआर के बाद इन राज्यों/केंद्रशासित प्रदेशों का संयुक्त मतदाता वर्ग 49.6 करोड़ से घटकर 45.2 करोड़ हो गया, लेकिन एसएसआर के परिणामस्वरूप ड्राफ्ट एसएसआर सूची में लगभग 46 करोड़ की रिकवरी हुई है; ऊपर।।

hinglishTracks.en: has highest number of voters added through SSR, but Goa sees highest growth in percentage terms
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — एसएसआर के माध्यम से सबसे अधिक संख्या में मतदाता जुड़े हैं, लेकिन प्रतिशत के मामले में गोवा में सबसे अधिक वृद्धि देखी गई है।

hinglishTracks.en: Months after final voters lists were published following the contentious special intensive revision (SIR) of electoral rolls, nearly 75 lakh more names have been added in draft voter lists published in 13 States and Union Territories via a special summary revision process (SSR).
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — मतदाता सूचियों के विवादास्पद विशेष गहन पुनरीक्षण (एसआईआर) के बाद अंतिम मतदाता सूचियां प्रकाशित होने के महीनों बाद, एक विशेष सारांश पुनरीक्षण प्रक्रिया (एसएसआर) के माध्यम से 13 राज्यों और केंद्र शासित प्रदेशों में प्रकाशित मसौदा मतदाता सूचियों में लगभग 75 लाख और नाम जोड़े गए हैं।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Contentious' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Contentious' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: The combined size of the electorate in these States before the SIR was 49.61 crore, which shrunk to 45.22 crore after the SIR and has now increased to 45.96 crore in the draft SSR list.

hinglishTracks.en: This means there has been a cumulative increase of 1.64 %.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — इसका मतलब है कि 1.64% की संचयी वृद्धि हुई है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Cumulative' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Cumulative' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: Uttar Pradesh, which published its draft SSR list on Tuesday (November 17, 2026), saw 18.84 lakh names being added to its voter lists, the largest in absolute numbers so far.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — उत्तर प्रदेश, जिसने मंगलवार (17 नवंबर, 2026) को अपनी मसौदा एसएसआर सूची प्रकाशित की, उसकी मतदाता सूची में 18.84 लाख नाम जोड़े गए, जो अब तक की पूर्ण संख्या में सबसे बड़ी संख्या है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Goa saw the highest rate of additions, at 3.01 %.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — गोवा में सबसे अधिक 3.01% वृद्धि दर देखी गई।।

hinglishTracks.en: Bihar, which was the first State to undergo the SIR process in 2025 saw 13.89 lakh names being added to the final post-SIR list.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — बिहार, जो 2025 में एसआईआर प्रक्रिया से गुजरने वाला पहला राज्य था, अंतिम एसआईआर सूची में 13.89 लाख नाम जोड़े गए थे।।

hinglishTracks.en: Rajasthan saw more than 11.48 lakh voters being added to the final SIR voter list, followed by Uttarakhand (1.19 lakh), Madhya Pradesh (8.9 lakh), and Tamil Nadu (10.39 lakh).
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — राजस्थान में अंतिम एसआईआर मतदाता सूची में 11.48 लाख से अधिक मतदाता जोड़े गए, इसके बाद उत्तराखंड (1.19 लाख), मध्य प्रदेश (8.9 लाख), और तमिलनाडु (10.39 लाख) का स्थान रहा।।

hinglishTracks.en: On November 5, it was expanded to six more States where the SIR process is over, and on November 16, it was announced that the SSR would also be conducted in Karnataka and Meghalaya.

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — एसएसआर, एक वार्षिक अभ्यास, आमतौर पर पात्र मतदाताओं, विशेष रूप से युवा और पहली बार मतदाताओं को नामांकित करने का प्रयास करता है, और उन लोगों से अग्रिम आवेदन की सुविधा प्रदान करता है जो 1 अप्रैल, 1 जुलाई और 1 अक्टूबर, 2027 को पात्र बन जाएंगे।।

hinglishTracks.en: However, it had not been carried out after the SIR was launched last year, an anomaly that was recently highlighted by Election Commissioners S.S.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — हालाँकि, पिछले साल एसआईआर लॉन्च होने के बाद इसे लागू नहीं किया गया था, एक विसंगति जिसे हाल ही में चुनाव आयुक्त एस.एस. ने उजागर किया था।।

hinglishTracks.en: Sandhu and Vivek Joshi.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — संधू और विवेक जोशी।।

hinglishTracks.en: Unlike the now contentious SIR process, when enrolling through the SSR, voters do not need to provide any documentation proving citizenship or be mapped with earlier electoral rolls.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — अब विवादास्पद एसआईआर प्रक्रिया के विपरीत, एसएसआर के माध्यम से नामांकन करते समय, मतदाताओं को नागरिकता साबित करने वाला कोई दस्तावेज प्रदान करने या पहले की मतदाता सूची के साथ मैप किए जाने की आवश्यकता नहीं होती है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Documentation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Documentation' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: Among the firsts, in this year’s SSR, the ECI has directed that, at the time of the polls, a “readable PDF” of the alphabetically arranged electoral rolls can be provided to the contesting candidates in a pen drive or any other electronic storage device.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — सबसे पहले, इस साल के एसएसआर में, ईसीआई ने निर्देश दिया है कि, चुनाव के समय, चुनाव लड़ने वाले उम्मीदवारों को पेन ड्राइव या किसी अन्य इलेक्ट्रॉनिक स्टोरेज डिवाइस में वर्णानुक्रम में व्यवस्थित मतदाता सूची की "पठनीय पीडीएफ" प्रदान की जा सकती है।।

hinglishTracks.en: This is crucial as Opposition parties have been demanding machine-readable electoral rolls rather than image-based PDFs, so that they are digitally searchable, indexable, and verifiable.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — यह महत्वपूर्ण है क्योंकि विपक्षी दल छवि-आधारित पीडीएफ के बजाय मशीन-पठनीय मतदाता सूची की मांग कर रहे हैं, ताकि वे डिजिटल रूप से खोजने योग्य, अनुक्रमित और सत्यापन योग्य हों।।

hinglishTracks.en: Political parties will also be provided with supplementary voter lists which were earlier kept only for records and future use.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — राजनीतिक दलों को पूरक मतदाता सूचियाँ भी प्रदान की जाएंगी जिन्हें पहले केवल रिकॉर्ड और भविष्य में उपयोग के लिए रखा जाता था।।

hinglishTracks.en: The SSR process this time not only features the usual house-to-house visits by Booth Level Officers, but also includes the publication and display of draft as well as final voter lists at the polling booths.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — इस बार एसएसआर प्रक्रिया में न केवल बूथ स्तर के अधिकारियों द्वारा सामान्य घर-घर का दौरा शामिल है, बल्कि मतदान केंद्रों पर ड्राफ्ट के साथ-साथ अंतिम मतदाता सूचियों का प्रकाशन और प्रदर्शन भी शामिल है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Publication' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: प्रकाशन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Publication' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #10 of 30 (17 NOV)

📰 Nearly 75 lakh names added in draft SSR voters lists in 13 States and UTs

📌 Published: 17 Nov 2026, 09:25:09 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: These States/UTs saw their combined electorate shrink from 49.6 cr to 45.2 cr post-SIR, but SSR has resulted in a recovery to almost 46 cr in draft SSR list; U.P. has highest number of voters added through SSR, but Goa sees highest growth in percentage terms

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Months after final voters lists were published following the contentious special intensive revision (SIR) of electoral rolls, nearly 75 lakh more names have been added in draft voter lists published in 13 States and Union Territories via a special summary revision process (SSR). The combined size of the electorate in these States before the SIR was 49.61 crore, which shrunk to 45.22 crore after the SIR and has now increased to 45.96 crore in the draft SSR list. This means there has been a cumulative increase of 1.64 %. Uttar Pradesh, which published its draft SSR list on Tuesday (November 17, 2026), saw 18.84 lakh names being added to its voter lists, the largest in absolute numbers so far. Goa saw the highest rate of additions, at 3.01 %. Bihar, which was the first State to undergo the SIR process in 2025 saw 13.89 lakh names being added to the final post-SIR list. Rajasthan saw more than 11.48 lakh voters being added to the final SIR voter list, followed by Uttarakhand (1.19 lakh), Madhya Pradesh (8.9 lakh), and Tamil Nadu (10.39 lakh). The SSR, on hold since the SIR process began last year, was first announced in 17 States and UTs, including poll-bound Uttarakhand, Uttar Pradesh, and Punjab, on October 15. On November 5, it was expanded to six more States where the SIR process is over, and on November 16, it was announced that the SSR would also be conducted in Karnataka and Meghalaya. Of these, the draft SSR rolls have been published for 15 States and UTs. The data for Punjab and Gujarat, however, was not available. The SSR, an annual exercise, usually seeks to enrol eligible voters, particularly young and first-time electors, and facilitate advance applications from those who will become eligible on April 1, July 1, and October 1, 2027. However, it had not been carried out after the SIR was launched last year, an anomaly that was recently highlighted by Election Commissioners S.S. Sandhu and Vivek Joshi. Unlike the now contentious SIR process, when enrolling through the SSR, voters do not need to provide any documentation proving citizenship or be mapped with earlier electoral rolls. Among the firsts, in this year’s SSR, the ECI has directed that, at the time of the polls, a “readable PDF” of the alphabetically arranged electoral rolls can be provided to the contesting candidates in a pen drive or any other electronic storage device. This is crucial as Opposition parties have been demanding machine-readable electoral rolls rather than image-based PDFs, so that they are digitally searchable, indexable, and verifiable. Political parties will also be provided with supplementary voter lists which were earlier kept only for records and future use.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The SSR process this time not only features the usual house-to-house visits by Booth Level Officers, but also includes the publication and display of draft as well as final voter lists at the polling booths.

✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Publication (Noun)
प्रकाशन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Publication' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Cumulative (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Cumulative' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।

🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:

Core Context & Background: These States/UTs saw their combined electorate shrink from 49.6 cr to 45.2 cr post-SIR, but SSR has resulted in a recovery to almost 46 cr in draft SSR list; U.P. has highest number of voters added through SSR, but Goa sees highest growth in percentage terms
articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: These States/UTs saw their combined electorate shrink from 49.6 cr to 45.2 cr post-SIR, but SSR has resulted in a recovery to almost 46 cr in draft SSR list; U.P. has highest number of voters added through SSR, but Goa sees highest growth in percentage terms
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Months after final voters lists were published following the contentious special intensive revision (SIR) of electoral rolls, nearly 75 lakh more names have been added in draft voter lists published in 13 States and Union Territories via a special summary revision process (SSR). The combined size of the electorate in these States before the SIR was 49.61 crore, which shrunk to 45.22 crore after the SIR and has now increased to 45.96 crore in the draft SSR list. This means there has been a cumulative increase of 1.64 %. Uttar Pradesh, which published its draft SSR list on Tuesday (November 17, 2026), saw 18.84 lakh names being added to its voter lists, the largest in absolute numbers so far. Goa saw the highest rate of additions, at 3.01 %. Bihar, which was the first State to undergo the SIR process in 2025 saw 13.89 lakh names being added to the final post-SIR list. Rajasthan saw more than 11.48 lakh voters being added to the final SIR voter list, followed by Uttarakhand (1.19 lakh), Madhya Pradesh (8.9 lakh), and Tamil Nadu (10.39 lakh). The SSR, on hold since the SIR process began last year, was first announced in 17 States and UTs, including poll-bound Uttarakhand, Uttar Pradesh, and Punjab, on October 15. On November 5, it was expanded to six more States where the SIR process is over, and on November 16, it was announced that the SSR would also be conducted in Karnataka and Meghalaya. Of these, the draft SSR rolls have been published for 15 States and UTs. The data for Punjab and Gujarat, however, was not available. The SSR, an annual exercise, usually seeks to enrol eligible voters, particularly young and first-time electors, and facilitate advance applications from those who will become eligible on April 1, July 1, and October 1, 2027. However, it had not been carried out after the SIR was launched last year, an anomaly that was recently highlighted by Election Commissioners S.S. Sandhu and Vivek Joshi. Unlike the now contentious SIR process, when enrolling through the SSR, voters do not need to provide any documentation proving citizenship or be mapped with earlier electoral rolls. Among the firsts, in this year’s SSR, the ECI has directed that, at the time of the polls, a “readable PDF” of the alphabetically arranged electoral rolls can be provided to the contesting candidates in a pen drive or any other electronic storage device. This is crucial as Opposition parties have been demanding machine-readable electoral rolls rather than image-based PDFs, so that they are digitally searchable, indexable, and verifiable. Political parties will also be provided with supplementary voter lists which were earlier kept only for records and future use.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The SSR process this time not only features the usual house-to-house visits by Booth Level Officers, but also includes the publication and display of draft as well as final voter lists at the polling booths.

articles.title: Naidu seeks immediate Central assistance to cope with damages caused by two cyclones
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The successive weather systems, ‘Arnab’ and ‘Murasu’, have inflicted losses estimated at over ₹7,000 crore, he informs Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman; he also urges release of funds for developing infrastructure for the Rayalaseema Horticulture Hub

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu has sought immediate financial assistance from the Union government to help the State cope with the damage caused by two successive cyclones (Arnab and Murasu), which inflicted losses estimated at over ₹7,000 crore. During a meeting with Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman in New Delhi on November 17, 2026 (Tuesday), Mr. Naidu explained the impact of the two cyclones on agriculture, power infrastructure and other sectors, and urged her to extend immediate financial support. He said crops nearing harvest had been damaged, leaving farmers in distress. Despite the impact of El Niño, the State had supplied irrigation water to some regions through the Pattiseema project to help the farmers, but the successive cyclones caused extensive crop losses, the Chief Minister said. Coastal infrastructure, particularly the power distribution network, suffered considerable damage. The Chief Minister said Central teams had visited the State to assess the damage and were expected to submit their reports soon. Immediate assistance, even before completion of the assessment process, would provide some financial relief to the State, he said. The Chief Minister also discussed region-wise development plans for Visakhapatnam, Amaravati and Tirupati. Mr. Naidu recalled that Ms. Sitharaman had laid the stone for the Rayalaseema Horticulture Hub, and sought the release of funds for developing supporting infrastructure, including rural roads, irrigation facilities and drip irrigation systems. He also sought additional Central assistance for the Visakhapatnam Economic Region (VER), saying it was witnessing rapid growth and that further support would help extend the benefits of development to the people. The Chief Minister briefed the Finance Minister about the recent CII Partnership Summit in Visakhapatnam, including the investment proposals and discussions held during the two-day event.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: State Finance Minister Payyavula Keshav, MPs and senior Finance Department officials attended the meeting.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #12 of 30 (17 NOV)

📰 Naidu seeks immediate Central assistance to cope with damages caused by two cyclones

📌 Published: 17 Nov 2026, 09:22:38 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The successive weather systems, ‘Arnab’ and ‘Murasu’, have inflicted losses estimated at over ₹7,000 crore, he informs Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman; he also urges release of funds for developing infrastructure for the Rayalaseema Horticulture Hub

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu has sought immediate financial assistance from the Union government to help the State cope with the damage caused by two successive cyclones (Arnab and Murasu), which inflicted losses estimated at over ₹7,000 crore. During a meeting with Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman in New Delhi on November 17, 2026 (Tuesday), Mr. Naidu explained the impact of the two cyclones on agriculture, power infrastructure and other sectors, and urged her to extend immediate financial support. He said crops nearing harvest had been damaged, leaving farmers in distress. Despite the impact of El Niño, the State had supplied irrigation water to some regions through the Pattiseema project to help the farmers, but the successive cyclones caused extensive crop losses, the Chief Minister said. Coastal infrastructure, particularly the power distribution network, suffered considerable damage. The Chief Minister said Central teams had visited the State to assess the damage and were expected to submit their reports soon. Immediate assistance, even before completion of the assessment process, would provide some financial relief to the State, he said. The Chief Minister also discussed region-wise development plans for Visakhapatnam, Amaravati and Tirupati. Mr. Naidu recalled that Ms. Sitharaman had laid the stone for the Rayalaseema Horticulture Hub, and sought the release of funds for developing supporting infrastructure, including rural roads, irrigation facilities and drip irrigation systems. He also sought additional Central assistance for the Visakhapatnam Economic Region (VER), saying it was witnessing rapid growth and that further support would help extend the benefits of development to the people. The Chief Minister briefed the Finance Minister about the recent CII Partnership Summit in Visakhapatnam, including the investment proposals and discussions held during the two-day event.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: State Finance Minister Payyavula Keshav, MPs and senior Finance Department officials attended the meeting.

✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Naidu seeks immediate Central assistance to cope with damages caused by two cyclones", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. The successive weather systems, ‘Arnab’ and ‘Murasu’, have inflicted losses estimated at over ₹7,000 crore, he informs Union Finance Minister Nirmala...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Naidu seeks immediate Central assistance to cope' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Naidu seeks immediate Central assistance to c' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Naidu seeks immediate Central assistance to c' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "The successive weather systems, ‘Arnab’ and ‘Murasu’, have inflicted losses estimated at over ₹7,000 crore, he informs Union Finance Minister Nirmala..." (Hinglish Arth: उन्होंने केंद्रीय वित्त मंत्री निर्मला सीतारमण को सूचित किया कि क्रमिक मौसम प्रणालियों, 'अर्नब' और 'मुरासु' ने अनुमानित रूप से ₹7,000 करोड़ से अधिक का नुकसान पहुंचाया है; उन्होंने बुनियादी ढांचे के विकास के लिए धन जारी करने का भी आग्रह किया)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Naidu seeks immediate Central assistance to cope with damages caused by two cyclones"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. State Finance Minister Payyavula Keshav, MPs and senior Finance Department officials attended the meeting.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "State Finance Minister Payyavula Keshav, MPs and senior Finance Department officials attended the meeting." (Hinglish Arth: बैठक में राज्य के वित्त मंत्री पय्यावुला केशव, सांसद और वित्त विभाग के वरिष्ठ अधिकारी शामिल हुए।)

articles.title: Rising prices reflect government’s economic mismanagement: Congress
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-III & IBPS/SBI/RBI/SSC: RBI Monetary Policy, GDP Growth, Inflation, Fiscal Deficit & Trade Balance
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Monthly costs up by over 20% for 61% of families, according to a survey cited by Congress leader Jairam Ramesh; claims PM is more pre-occupied with politics than tackling the inflation crisis

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Congress on Tuesday (November 17, 2026) accused the Union government of fuelling inflation through its “economic mismanagement and anti-people policies” and alleged that Prime Minister Narendra Modi remained preoccupied with politics rather than addressing the economic distress faced by households and businesses. Congress general secretary (communications) Jairam Ramesh cited a survey which found that, for 61% of families across the country, monthly household expenditure had risen by more than 20% over the past year. While 74% of respondents were cutting back on non-essential spending, 50% had reduced purchases of essential goods, he said. Citing the survey, Mr. Ramesh said prices of ghee and edible oils had risen by 75%, vegetables by 73%, cereals by 71%, milk and dairy products by 65%, and pulses by 62%. He also claimed that 200 garment factories had shut down in Noida over the past year, citing the impact of U.S. tariffs, high input costs, and government apathy. He said the closures reflected the wider distress in the textile industry. “People’s plates are shrinking, and factories are being locked down. Yet, the Prime Minister’s only concern remains politics,” he said on X, accusing the government of failing to acknowledge people’s hardships or offer relief.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Indian National Congress / national government / Bharatiya Janata Party / Narendra Modi / inflation and deflation

📈 Economic, Banking & Finance Paragraph #13 of 30 (17 NOV)

📰 Rising prices reflect government’s economic mismanagement: Congress

📌 Published: 17 Nov 2026, 09:09:04 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Monthly costs up by over 20% for 61% of families, according to a survey cited by Congress leader Jairam Ramesh; claims PM is more pre-occupied with politics than tackling the inflation crisis

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Congress on Tuesday (November 17, 2026) accused the Union government of fuelling inflation through its “economic mismanagement and anti-people policies” and alleged that Prime Minister Narendra Modi remained preoccupied with politics rather than addressing the economic distress faced by households and businesses. Congress general secretary (communications) Jairam Ramesh cited a survey which found that, for 61% of families across the country, monthly household expenditure had risen by more than 20% over the past year. While 74% of respondents were cutting back on non-essential spending, 50% had reduced purchases of essential goods, he said. Citing the survey, Mr. Ramesh said prices of ghee and edible oils had risen by 75%, vegetables by 73%, cereals by 71%, milk and dairy products by 65%, and pulses by 62%. He also claimed that 200 garment factories had shut down in Noida over the past year, citing the impact of U.S. tariffs, high input costs, and government apathy. He said the closures reflected the wider distress in the textile industry. “People’s plates are shrinking, and factories are being locked down. Yet, the Prime Minister’s only concern remains politics,” he said on X, accusing the government of failing to acknowledge people’s hardships or offer relief.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Indian National Congress / national government / Bharatiya Janata Party / Narendra Modi / inflation and deflation

महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Essential' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile

महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Deflation' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable

C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Rising prices reflect government’s economic m' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Rising prices reflect government’s economic m' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.

articles.title: India cannot dictate terms on Hasina’s return to Bangladesh: PM’s adviser
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Hasina has been staying in India since fleeing the country in August 2024 following a student-led uprising that toppled her government

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Bangladesh Prime Minister Tarique Rahman’s Information Adviser Zahed Ur Rahman on Tuesday (November 17, 2026) said that India or any other country could not dictate terms over deposed Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina’s return home. Hasina has been staying in India since fleeing the country in August 2024 following a student-led uprising that toppled her government. Talking to reporters at the Bangladesh Secretariat, Mr. Zahed said, “Bangladesh is now an independent, sovereign state standing on firm legal ground and it will reject any unjust terms.” The premier’s Adviser, however, said he did not believe India would attach conditions to returning Hasina. On Friday (November 13, 2026), Ministry of External Affairs spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal said Hasina's extradition was a legal matter and would be dealt with accordingly. He further said: “India desires a positive, constructive and forward-looking relationship with Bangladesh." Bangladesh's International Crimes Tribunal convicted Hasina in November 2025 of crimes against humanity for her role in the crackdown on protesters during the July-August 2024 uprising. Tried in absentia, she was sentenced to death on one charge and life imprisonment on another. Hasina has rejected the charges and the proceedings. In a report last week, BBC Bangla said unnamed Indian officials indicated that New Delhi set two main conditions to facilitate Hasina’s return amid Dhaka’s repeated insistence on her extradition under a bilateral treaty despite her repeated stated plan to return home voluntarily to face the legal procedure.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The report said that “under the conditions, India wanted Bangladesh Army to directly receive Hasina either via a military flight to Delhi or at a land border crossing”.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #19 of 30 (17 NOV)

📰 India cannot dictate terms on Hasina’s return to Bangladesh: PM’s adviser

📌 Published: 17 Nov 2026, 09:07:11 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Hasina has been staying in India since fleeing the country in August 2024 following a student-led uprising that toppled her government

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Bangladesh Prime Minister Tarique Rahman’s Information Adviser Zahed Ur Rahman on Tuesday (November 17, 2026) said that India or any other country could not dictate terms over deposed Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina’s return home. Hasina has been staying in India since fleeing the country in August 2024 following a student-led uprising that toppled her government. Talking to reporters at the Bangladesh Secretariat, Mr. Zahed said, “Bangladesh is now an independent, sovereign state standing on firm legal ground and it will reject any unjust terms.” The premier’s Adviser, however, said he did not believe India would attach conditions to returning Hasina. On Friday (November 13, 2026), Ministry of External Affairs spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal said Hasina's extradition was a legal matter and would be dealt with accordingly. He further said: “India desires a positive, constructive and forward-looking relationship with Bangladesh." Bangladesh's International Crimes Tribunal convicted Hasina in November 2025 of crimes against humanity for her role in the crackdown on protesters during the July-August 2024 uprising. Tried in absentia, she was sentenced to death on one charge and life imprisonment on another. Hasina has rejected the charges and the proceedings. In a report last week, BBC Bangla said unnamed Indian officials indicated that New Delhi set two main conditions to facilitate Hasina’s return amid Dhaka’s repeated insistence on her extradition under a bilateral treaty despite her repeated stated plan to return home voluntarily to face the legal procedure.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The report said that “under the conditions, India wanted Bangladesh Army to directly receive Hasina either via a military flight to Delhi or at a land border crossing”.

द्विपक्षीय — दो देशों के बीच आपसी समझौता, व्यापार या कूटनीतिक बातचीत।

महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Constructive' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Imprisonment (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Imprisonment' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🌐 International & Geopolitics passage on "India cannot dictate terms on Hasina’s return to Bangladesh: PM’s adviser", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Hasina has been staying in India since fleeing the country in August 2024 following a student-led uprising that toppled her government.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'India cannot dictate terms on Hasina’s return to' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'India cannot dictate terms on Hasina’s return' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'India cannot dictate terms on Hasina’s return' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Hasina has been staying in India since fleeing the country in August 2024 following a student-led uprising that toppled her government." Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "India cannot dictate terms on Hasina’s return to Bangladesh: PM’s adviser"?

C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Quad is a ‘trusted partnership’ delivering solutions, says PM Modi

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Prime Minister Narendra Modi departed for New Delhi after concluding his two-day visit to the Philippines, during which he attended the ASEAN-India Summit, the East Asia Summit and a meeting of the Quad leaders. Mr. Modi also met Philippine President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr., and the two leaders discussed ways to strengthen bilateral cooperation in defence, security, trade and investment. The Prime Minister also discussed regional and global issues of mutual interest with his counterparts from Singapore and Thailand on the sidelines of the visit. Leaders of ‌the four-nation Quad grouping ⁠strongly oppose any destabilising or ‌unilateral actions that seek ‌to ‌change ⁠the status ⁠quo, including by force or coercion, which ‌escalate tensions and undermine regional peace and ‌stability, a joint statement said. The leaders also ‌expressed grave concerns about economic coercion, including through arbitrary ‌export restrictions, the statement added after their ⁠meeting in Manila. The Quad grouping, following its meeting in Manila, announced the ‘Indo-Pacific Maritime Surveillance Collaboration’ which is “ a new initiative to enhance information sharing and maritime domain awareness” “In 2027, our respective P-8 and P-3C patrol aircraft are scheduled to fly in a maritime exercise for the first time in a Quad context, making our seas safer,” the statement added. In a joint press release following the Quad meeting in Manila, the group said that it “affirms the importance of the AI Accelerator, announced by our Foreign Ministers in Atlanta.” “The Accelerator is intended to coordinate and fund efforts to support trusted AI access, deployment, and technical assistance across the Indo-Pacific,” it added.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Prime Minister Narendra Modi discussed ways to strengthen cooperation and exchanged views on regional and global developments with his counterparts from Singapore and Thailand in separate bilateral meetings in the Philippines.

hinglishTracks.en: Quad is a ‘trusted partnership’ delivering solutions, says PM Modi
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — पीएम मोदी ने कहा, क्वाड एक 'विश्वसनीय साझेदारी' है जो समाधान प्रदान करती है।

hinglishTracks.en: Prime Minister Narendra Modi departed for New Delhi after concluding his two-day visit to the Philippines, during which he attended the ASEAN-India Summit, the East Asia Summit and a meeting of the Quad leaders.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — प्रधान मंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी फिलीपींस की अपनी दो दिवसीय यात्रा समाप्त करने के बाद नई दिल्ली के लिए रवाना हुए, इस दौरान उन्होंने आसियान-भारत शिखर सम्मेलन, पूर्वी एशिया शिखर सम्मेलन और क्वाड नेताओं की बैठक में भाग लिया।।

hinglishTracks.en: Modi also met Philippine President Ferdinand R.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — मोदी ने फिलीपींस के राष्ट्रपति फर्डिनेंड आर से भी मुलाकात की।।

hinglishTracks.en: Marcos Jr., and the two leaders discussed ways to strengthen bilateral cooperation in defence, security, trade and investment.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — मार्कोस जूनियर और दोनों नेताओं ने रक्षा, सुरक्षा, व्यापार और निवेश में द्विपक्षीय सहयोग को मजबूत करने के तरीकों पर चर्चा की।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Bilateral' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: द्विपक्षीय — दो देशों के बीच आपसी समझौता, व्यापार या कूटनीतिक बातचीत। इसके Synonyms हैं: Reciprocal, Two-sided, Mutual और Antonyms हैं: Unilateral, Multilateral, One-way।

hinglishTracks.en: The Prime Minister also discussed regional and global issues of mutual interest with his counterparts from Singapore and Thailand on the sidelines of the visit.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — प्रधानमंत्री ने यात्रा से इतर सिंगापुर और थाईलैंड के अपने समकक्षों के साथ आपसी हित के क्षेत्रीय और वैश्विक मुद्दों पर भी चर्चा की।।

hinglishTracks.en: Leaders of ‌the four-nation Quad grouping ⁠strongly oppose any destabilising or ‌unilateral actions that seek ‌to ‌change ⁠the status ⁠quo, including by force or coercion, which ‌escalate tensions and undermine regional peace and ‌stability, a joint statement said.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — एक संयुक्त बयान में कहा गया है कि चार देशों के क्वाड समूह के नेता किसी भी अस्थिर करने वाली या एकतरफा कार्रवाई का दृढ़ता से विरोध करते हैं, जो स्थिति को बदलने की कोशिश करती है, जिसमें बल या ज़ोर-जबरदस्ती भी शामिल है, जो तनाव को बढ़ाती है और क्षेत्रीय शांति और स्थिरता को कमजोर करती है।।

hinglishTracks.en: The leaders also ‌expressed grave concerns about economic coercion, including through arbitrary ‌export restrictions, the statement added after their ⁠meeting in Manila.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — मनीला में उनकी बैठक के बाद बयान में कहा गया, नेताओं ने आर्थिक दबाव के बारे में भी गंभीर चिंता व्यक्त की, जिसमें मनमाने ढंग से निर्यात प्रतिबंध भी शामिल हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: The Quad grouping, following its meeting in Manila, announced the ‘Indo-Pacific Maritime Surveillance Collaboration’ which is “ a new initiative to enhance information sharing and maritime domain awareness”
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — मनीला में अपनी बैठक के बाद क्वाड समूह ने 'इंडो-पैसिफिक समुद्री निगरानी सहयोग' की घोषणा की, जो "सूचना साझाकरण और समुद्री डोमेन जागरूकता बढ़ाने के लिए एक नई पहल है"। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Collaboration' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Collaboration' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: “In 2027, our respective P-8 and P-3C patrol aircraft are scheduled to fly in a maritime exercise for the first time in a Quad context, making our seas safer,” the statement added.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — बयान में कहा गया है, "2027 में, हमारे संबंधित पी-8 और पी-3सी गश्ती विमान क्वाड संदर्भ में पहली बार समुद्री अभ्यास में उड़ान भरने वाले हैं, जिससे हमारे समुद्र सुरक्षित हो जाएंगे।"।

hinglishTracks.en: In a joint press release following the Quad meeting in Manila, the group said that it “affirms the importance of the AI Accelerator, announced by our Foreign Ministers in Atlanta.”
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — मनीला में क्वाड बैठक के बाद एक संयुक्त प्रेस विज्ञप्ति में, समूह ने कहा कि यह "अटलांटा में हमारे विदेश मंत्रियों द्वारा घोषित एआई एक्सेलेरेटर के महत्व की पुष्टि करता है।"।

hinglishTracks.en: “The Accelerator is intended to coordinate and fund efforts to support trusted AI access, deployment, and technical assistance across the Indo-Pacific,” it added.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — इसमें कहा गया है, "एक्सीलरेटर का उद्देश्य पूरे इंडो-पैसिफिक में विश्वसनीय एआई पहुंच, तैनाती और तकनीकी सहायता का समर्थन करने के प्रयासों का समन्वय और वित्तपोषण करना है।"।

hinglishTracks.en: Prime Minister Narendra Modi discussed ways to strengthen cooperation and exchanged views on regional and global developments with his counterparts from Singapore and Thailand in separate bilateral meetings in the Philippines.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — प्रधान मंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी ने फिलीपींस में अलग-अलग द्विपक्षीय बैठकों में सिंगापुर और थाईलैंड के अपने समकक्षों के साथ सहयोग को मजबूत करने के तरीकों पर चर्चा की और क्षेत्रीय और वैश्विक विकास पर विचारों का आदान-प्रदान किया।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Bilateral' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: द्विपक्षीय — दो देशों के बीच आपसी समझौता, व्यापार या कूटनीतिक बातचीत। इसके Synonyms हैं: Reciprocal, Two-sided, Mutual और Antonyms हैं: Unilateral, Multilateral, One-way।

📰 ASEAN Summit LIVE updates: Quad announces new maritime exercise, unveils major initiatives on AI, cyber security

🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Quad is a ‘trusted partnership’ delivering solutions, says PM Modi

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Prime Minister Narendra Modi departed for New Delhi after concluding his two-day visit to the Philippines, during which he attended the ASEAN-India Summit, the East Asia Summit and a meeting of the Quad leaders. Mr. Modi also met Philippine President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr., and the two leaders discussed ways to strengthen bilateral cooperation in defence, security, trade and investment. The Prime Minister also discussed regional and global issues of mutual interest with his counterparts from Singapore and Thailand on the sidelines of the visit. Leaders of ‌the four-nation Quad grouping ⁠strongly oppose any destabilising or ‌unilateral actions that seek ‌to ‌change ⁠the status ⁠quo, including by force or coercion, which ‌escalate tensions and undermine regional peace and ‌stability, a joint statement said. The leaders also ‌expressed grave concerns about economic coercion, including through arbitrary ‌export restrictions, the statement added after their ⁠meeting in Manila. The Quad grouping, following its meeting in Manila, announced the ‘Indo-Pacific Maritime Surveillance Collaboration’ which is “ a new initiative to enhance information sharing and maritime domain awareness” “In 2027, our respective P-8 and P-3C patrol aircraft are scheduled to fly in a maritime exercise for the first time in a Quad context, making our seas safer,” the statement added. In a joint press release following the Quad meeting in Manila, the group said that it “affirms the importance of the AI Accelerator, announced by our Foreign Ministers in Atlanta.” “The Accelerator is intended to coordinate and fund efforts to support trusted AI access, deployment, and technical assistance across the Indo-Pacific,” it added.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Prime Minister Narendra Modi discussed ways to strengthen cooperation and exchanged views on regional and global developments with his counterparts from Singapore and Thailand in separate bilateral meetings in the Philippines.

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: One of the best Zelda games, Ocarina of Time, has got a gorgeous new remake that is worth playing, if you have a Switch 2

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Remakes of past games are pure genius. There are several titles that were mega hits in the 90s or early 2000s when both silicon and game engines were breaking new ground in 3D. Many of those games do not hold up today as well as the pixel game era of the NES and SNES eras do. Capcom has shown the world that remaking most of their lineup of Resident Evils has been successful. Ubisoft did it too, with Assassin’s Creed: Black Flag Resynced . No one expected Nintendo to jump into the fray, but they did and with style, not only remaking a Zelda game, but one of the cult favorites from the Nintendo 64 era. A game so loved, that it is continuously ranked as one of the greatest games of all times, which is a risky move to remake. Fortunately, the Ocarina of Time remake not only wears that crown proudly, but is also the only game this year to challenge the sales might of the neon clad tsunami that is Grand Theft Auto VI . Another saga begins in the cyclic battle of good versus evil, and it revolves around the only boy in the village without a fairy. Entrusted with the fate of the world Link must stop the evil Ganondorf who is intent on grabbing the Tri-force — an artefact that grants the bearer immense power. Guided by the enigmatic fairy Navi, Link must leave the safety of his home, Kokiri Forest, and journey across the sprawling expanse of Hyrule Field, venturing through perilous dungeons, and shift between childhood and adulthood to claim the Master Sword and become the Hero of Time. Jumping between time from Link’s adult self to his child form is so meta, it will make you feel like you too are jumping through time with him. As an adult, tethered by responsibilities of adulting, you get to jump back to your childhood — something that is more poignant than nostalgia. In comparison to some of the more sweeping, complex narratives of today’s fantasy games, Ocarina of Time harks back to a simplistic form of storytelling, which was mostly due to cartridge size restrictions. However, it is a template that many of Zelda’s best games have been set on. First-time players are sure to find Link’s story a refreshing one that focuses on core gameplay mechanics and a beautiful reimagining of the world. The world is gorgeous and while it is not quite open, it does feel like it has got a lot of freedom of movement. It is great to explore all the temples filled with its well-created puzzles that you may remember the solutions for and see the new renditions of iconic places such as Death Mountain, Hyrule Field, Temple of Time and other faithful to their original designs, but are now a lot more fleshed out. Much of the world has a lot more detail. So rather than rushing through the game, take in your surroundings and scrutinise houses, because there is environmental storytelling peppered everywhere. Much of the game has been faithfully translated, but thankfully it is free from the oddities of that N64 controller. In addition to updated control mechanics, there are a lot of quality of life improvements, and those who have played Breath of the Wild and Tears of the Kingdom , may find the controls familiar. The motions are fluid, and there are some physics-based systems at play, that make everything from the sword clashes feel solid to the sensation of things being physically there in the world as they bounce around.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Combat gains quality of life improvements, inheriting motion aiming from its predecessors making it more snappy, lively and reactive. It lets you acrobatically dodge, backflip and attack enemies, and hits do feel like they actually connect. The enemy AI and animations have been changed to make those fights all the more nail-biting. This being the Switch 2, there are also motion controls to help you use Hookshot, Longshots, bows for some more dynamic ranged combat, if you preferred using this in the newer Zelda games. The addition of jump mechanics do change the dungeons a bit, meaning instead of having the original jump in certain zones, now you actually have to platform across.

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #25 of 30 (17 NOV)

📰 The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time improves an already perfect classic

📌 Published: 17 Nov 2026, 09:06:19 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: One of the best Zelda games, Ocarina of Time, has got a gorgeous new remake that is worth playing, if you have a Switch 2

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Remakes of past games are pure genius. There are several titles that were mega hits in the 90s or early 2000s when both silicon and game engines were breaking new ground in 3D. Many of those games do not hold up today as well as the pixel game era of the NES and SNES eras do. Capcom has shown the world that remaking most of their lineup of Resident Evils has been successful. Ubisoft did it too, with Assassin’s Creed: Black Flag Resynced . No one expected Nintendo to jump into the fray, but they did and with style, not only remaking a Zelda game, but one of the cult favorites from the Nintendo 64 era. A game so loved, that it is continuously ranked as one of the greatest games of all times, which is a risky move to remake. Fortunately, the Ocarina of Time remake not only wears that crown proudly, but is also the only game this year to challenge the sales might of the neon clad tsunami that is Grand Theft Auto VI . Another saga begins in the cyclic battle of good versus evil, and it revolves around the only boy in the village without a fairy. Entrusted with the fate of the world Link must stop the evil Ganondorf who is intent on grabbing the Tri-force — an artefact that grants the bearer immense power. Guided by the enigmatic fairy Navi, Link must leave the safety of his home, Kokiri Forest, and journey across the sprawling expanse of Hyrule Field, venturing through perilous dungeons, and shift between childhood and adulthood to claim the Master Sword and become the Hero of Time. Jumping between time from Link’s adult self to his child form is so meta, it will make you feel like you too are jumping through time with him. As an adult, tethered by responsibilities of adulting, you get to jump back to your childhood — something that is more poignant than nostalgia. In comparison to some of the more sweeping, complex narratives of today’s fantasy games, Ocarina of Time harks back to a simplistic form of storytelling, which was mostly due to cartridge size restrictions. However, it is a template that many of Zelda’s best games have been set on. First-time players are sure to find Link’s story a refreshing one that focuses on core gameplay mechanics and a beautiful reimagining of the world. The world is gorgeous and while it is not quite open, it does feel like it has got a lot of freedom of movement. It is great to explore all the temples filled with its well-created puzzles that you may remember the solutions for and see the new renditions of iconic places such as Death Mountain, Hyrule Field, Temple of Time and other faithful to their original designs, but are now a lot more fleshed out. Much of the world has a lot more detail. So rather than rushing through the game, take in your surroundings and scrutinise houses, because there is environmental storytelling peppered everywhere. Much of the game has been faithfully translated, but thankfully it is free from the oddities of that N64 controller. In addition to updated control mechanics, there are a lot of quality of life improvements, and those who have played Breath of the Wild and Tears of the Kingdom , may find the controls familiar. The motions are fluid, and there are some physics-based systems at play, that make everything from the sword clashes feel solid to the sensation of things being physically there in the world as they bounce around.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Combat gains quality of life improvements, inheriting motion aiming from its predecessors making it more snappy, lively and reactive. It lets you acrobatically dodge, backflip and attack enemies, and hits do feel like they actually connect. The enemy AI and animations have been changed to make those fights all the more nail-biting. This being the Switch 2, there are also motion controls to help you use Hookshot, Longshots, bows for some more dynamic ranged combat, if you preferred using this in the newer Zelda games. The addition of jump mechanics do change the dungeons a bit, meaning instead of having the original jump in certain zones, now you actually have to platform across.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Environmental (Adjective)
पर्यावरण, प्रकृति और हमारे पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र (Ecosystem) से संबंधित।
✓ Syn: Ecological, Biospheric, Natural  |  ✖ Ant: Industrial, Polluting, Synthetic
Simplistic (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Simplistic' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Enigmatic (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Enigmatic' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Sensation (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Sensation' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🚀 Science, Tech & Environment passage on "The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time improves an already perfect classic", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. One of the best Zelda games, Ocarina of Time, has got a gorgeous new remake that is worth playing, if you have a Switch 2.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time improves an' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time improves' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time improves' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "One of the best Zelda games, Ocarina of Time, has got a gorgeous new remake that is worth playing, if you have a Switch 2." (Hinglish Arth: सबसे अच्छे ज़ेल्डा गेम्स में से एक, ओकारिना ऑफ टाइम को एक शानदार नया रीमेक मिला है जो खेलने लायक है, अगर आपके पास स्विच 2 है)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time improves an already perfect classic"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. The addition of jump mechanics do change the dungeons a bit, meaning instead of having the original jump in certain zones, now you actually have to...
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "The addition of jump mechanics do change the dungeons a bit, meaning instead of having the original jump in certain zones, now you actually have to..." (Hinglish Arth: जंप मैकेनिक्स को जोड़ने से कालकोठरी में थोड़ा बदलाव आता है, जिसका अर्थ है कि कुछ क्षेत्रों में मूल जंप करने के बजाय, अब आपको वास्तव में प्लेटफ़ॉर्म पार करना होगा।)

articles.title: Hospital in Chennai performs complex aortic surgery on 10-year-old boy with rare vascular disease
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The child recovered and was discharged on the ninth day after surgery

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A 10-year-old with a rare inflammatory blood vessel disease underwent surgery at SIMS Hospital, Chennai, to repair a large aneurysm of the aortic arch, the hospital said on Tuesday (November 17, 2026). The patient was diagnosed with aortoarteritis, also known as Takayasu arteritis, a condition that causes inflammation and narrowing or enlargement of blood vessels. The aneurysm had enlarged significantly, causing breathing difficulty, palpitations, and difficulty lying down. The risk of rupture made urgent surgery necessary. The patient weighed about 18 kg, adding to the technical challenges of the operation. As the aneurysm was located close to the breastbone, opening the chest through the usual approach carried a risk of injuring the enlarged aorta. The surgical team first connected the patient to a heart-lung machine through blood vessels in the groin. The patient’s body was cooled to 16°C using a technique known as deep hypothermic circulatory arrest. Blood circulation was then temporarily stopped for about 40 minutes, enabling surgeons to remove the affected section of the aorta and replace it with a Dacron graft. Lowering the body temperature reduces metabolic activity and the organs’ oxygen requirements, helping protect them during the period when blood flow is interrupted. The patient was subsequently rewarmed, restoring his blood circulation. Post-operative assessments showed no damage to the brain, kidneys, intestines, or spinal cord, the hospital said. The patient has resumed normal activities without breathing difficulty but will require continued medication and monitoring to control the underlying inflammation and prevent further aneurysms.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The surgery was performed by a team led by Bashi V. Velayudhan, director and senior consultant, cardiothoracic surgery, along with Mohammed Idhrees, senior consultant, cardiothoracic surgery, and a team of anaesthesiologists and other specialists.

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #26 of 30 (17 NOV)

📰 Hospital in Chennai performs complex aortic surgery on 10-year-old boy with rare vascular disease

📌 Published: 17 Nov 2026, 09:05:41 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The child recovered and was discharged on the ninth day after surgery

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A 10-year-old with a rare inflammatory blood vessel disease underwent surgery at SIMS Hospital, Chennai, to repair a large aneurysm of the aortic arch, the hospital said on Tuesday (November 17, 2026). The patient was diagnosed with aortoarteritis, also known as Takayasu arteritis, a condition that causes inflammation and narrowing or enlargement of blood vessels. The aneurysm had enlarged significantly, causing breathing difficulty, palpitations, and difficulty lying down. The risk of rupture made urgent surgery necessary. The patient weighed about 18 kg, adding to the technical challenges of the operation. As the aneurysm was located close to the breastbone, opening the chest through the usual approach carried a risk of injuring the enlarged aorta. The surgical team first connected the patient to a heart-lung machine through blood vessels in the groin. The patient’s body was cooled to 16°C using a technique known as deep hypothermic circulatory arrest. Blood circulation was then temporarily stopped for about 40 minutes, enabling surgeons to remove the affected section of the aorta and replace it with a Dacron graft. Lowering the body temperature reduces metabolic activity and the organs’ oxygen requirements, helping protect them during the period when blood flow is interrupted. The patient was subsequently rewarmed, restoring his blood circulation. Post-operative assessments showed no damage to the brain, kidneys, intestines, or spinal cord, the hospital said. The patient has resumed normal activities without breathing difficulty but will require continued medication and monitoring to control the underlying inflammation and prevent further aneurysms.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The surgery was performed by a team led by Bashi V. Velayudhan, director and senior consultant, cardiothoracic surgery, along with Mohammed Idhrees, senior consultant, cardiothoracic surgery, and a team of anaesthesiologists and other specialists.

Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A 10-year-old with a rare inflammatory blood vessel disease underwent surgery at SIMS Hospital, Chennai, to repair a large aneurysm of the aortic arch, the hospital said on Tuesday (November 17, 2026). The patient was diagnosed with aortoarteritis, also known as Takayasu arteritis, a condition that causes inflammation and narrowing or enlargement of blood vessels. The aneurysm had enlarged significantly, causing breathing difficulty, palpitations, and difficulty lying down. The risk of rupture made urgent surgery necessary. The patient weighed about 18 kg, adding to the technical challenges of the operation. As the aneurysm was located close to the breastbone, opening the chest through the usual approach carried a risk of injuring the enlarged aorta. The surgical team first connected the patient to a heart-lung machine through blood vessels in the groin. The patient’s body was cooled to 16°C using a technique known as deep hypothermic circulatory arrest. Blood circulation was then temporarily stopped for about 40 minutes, enabling surgeons to remove the affected section of the aorta and replace it with a Dacron graft. Lowering the body temperature reduces metabolic activity and the organs’ oxygen requirements, helping protect them during the period when blood flow is interrupted. The patient was subsequently rewarmed, restoring his blood circulation. Post-operative assessments showed no damage to the brain, kidneys, intestines, or spinal cord, the hospital said. The patient has resumed normal activities without breathing difficulty but will require continued medication and monitoring to control the underlying inflammation and prevent further aneurysms.

• 1. Core Context & Background: The child who died had a rare neurodevelopmental condition called Snijders Blok-Campeau syndrome, according to the report
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A Chinese scientist who concealed the death of a six-year-old girl in a gene-editing trial has been sacked following a government probe, according to state media. The girl died last year after receiving experimental gene therapy to correct a non-life-threatening condition -- which was not disclosed in published research, an investigation found in July. Neuroscientist Zilong Qiu, the trial's lead researcher, had made no mention of the girl in a paper published in the prestigious journal Nature , according to the joint investigation by Science and Retraction Watch . Qiu was dismissed as deputy director of the Songjiang Research Institute affiliated with Shanghai Jiao Tong University, state broadcaster CCTV said Friday, citing a statement from Shanghai authorities. The reported statement included only Qiu's surname, but referenced the Nature study published on February 18. Qiu was given a five-year suspension from participating in scientific projects and recorded in a database for "serious breaches of research integrity", the report said. Another researcher on Qiu's team was sacked and handed a five-year suspension, while several others with ties to the hospital where the trial took place were also punished. The child who died had a rare neurodevelopmental condition called Snijders Blok-Campeau syndrome, according to the report. The hospital's ethics committee had approved a gene-editing trial to treat the disorder in January 2025, the report said.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The committee terminated the study after the girl died in March due to complications from gene therapy.

articles.title: Microplastics, 'cocktail' of hazardous chemicals in Delhi's Yamuna, flags study
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The researchers also identified pharmaceutical compounds such as atomoxetine, domperidone and telmisartan, along with agrochemical-related substances, including diuron and thiamethoxam

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Microplastics in the Yamuna in Delhi are accompanied by a complex mixture of organic chemicals, including pharmaceutical residues, pesticides and industrial effluents, with many of these substances classified as human-health and environmental hazards, according to a new study by University of Delhi researchers. The study, published in the 'Journal of Hazardous Materials Advances ' in September 2026, examines microplastic pollution and associated chemical profiles at eight locations along a 48.8-km stretch of the river in Delhi -- from its entry at Palla to its exit at Asgarpur Jagir -- highlighting how pollution patterns vary across agricultural, residential, industrial, recreational and forested areas. Researchers recovered 2,289 microplastic particles from the samples, with an average abundance of 3.18 particles per litre. The analysis identified 321 distinct chemical compounds across the samples, of which 50 were detected in extracts of recovered microplastic fractions at four or more locations. Of these 50 compounds, 36 corresponded to structures with Global Harmonized System (GHS) hazard classifications, covering categories such as carcinogenicity, reproductive toxicity, acute toxicity and aquatic hazards. Seven compounds were detected across all eight sampling locations, including 2-naphthylamine, lidocaine and monobutyl phthalate, the study found. The researchers also identified pharmaceutical compounds such as atomoxetine, domperidone and telmisartan, along with agrochemical-related substances, including diuron and thiamethoxam. Radhey Shyam Sharma, head of the Department of Environmental Studies at University of Delhi and one of the co-authors of the study, said the findings highlight the need to look beyond microplastic particles and examine the complex chemical mixtures present in river ecosystems. "The microplastics problem, along with this cocktail of organic and inorganic substances, needs to be looked at through the lens of mixture toxicity. The land-use pattern has also been explored in the study," Sharma said. He stressed the importance of nature-based solutions, including strengthening vegetation along riverbanks and protecting natural river ecosystems, to minimise pollution-related risks.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: "Vegetation ecosystems can help prevent pollution from entering the river. Natural ecosystems and riverbanks need to be strengthened to minimise these risks. The focus should be on nature-based solutions," he said.

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #29 of 30 (17 NOV)

📰 Microplastics, 'cocktail' of hazardous chemicals in Delhi's Yamuna, flags study

📌 Published: 17 Nov 2026, 08:03:28 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The researchers also identified pharmaceutical compounds such as atomoxetine, domperidone and telmisartan, along with agrochemical-related substances, including diuron and thiamethoxam

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Microplastics in the Yamuna in Delhi are accompanied by a complex mixture of organic chemicals, including pharmaceutical residues, pesticides and industrial effluents, with many of these substances classified as human-health and environmental hazards, according to a new study by University of Delhi researchers. The study, published in the 'Journal of Hazardous Materials Advances ' in September 2026, examines microplastic pollution and associated chemical profiles at eight locations along a 48.8-km stretch of the river in Delhi -- from its entry at Palla to its exit at Asgarpur Jagir -- highlighting how pollution patterns vary across agricultural, residential, industrial, recreational and forested areas. Researchers recovered 2,289 microplastic particles from the samples, with an average abundance of 3.18 particles per litre. The analysis identified 321 distinct chemical compounds across the samples, of which 50 were detected in extracts of recovered microplastic fractions at four or more locations. Of these 50 compounds, 36 corresponded to structures with Global Harmonized System (GHS) hazard classifications, covering categories such as carcinogenicity, reproductive toxicity, acute toxicity and aquatic hazards. Seven compounds were detected across all eight sampling locations, including 2-naphthylamine, lidocaine and monobutyl phthalate, the study found. The researchers also identified pharmaceutical compounds such as atomoxetine, domperidone and telmisartan, along with agrochemical-related substances, including diuron and thiamethoxam. Radhey Shyam Sharma, head of the Department of Environmental Studies at University of Delhi and one of the co-authors of the study, said the findings highlight the need to look beyond microplastic particles and examine the complex chemical mixtures present in river ecosystems. "The microplastics problem, along with this cocktail of organic and inorganic substances, needs to be looked at through the lens of mixture toxicity. The land-use pattern has also been explored in the study," Sharma said. He stressed the importance of nature-based solutions, including strengthening vegetation along riverbanks and protecting natural river ecosystems, to minimise pollution-related risks.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: "Vegetation ecosystems can help prevent pollution from entering the river. Natural ecosystems and riverbanks need to be strengthened to minimise these risks. The focus should be on nature-based solutions," he said.

Environmental (Adjective)
पर्यावरण, प्रकृति और हमारे पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र (Ecosystem) से संबंधित।

Carcinogenicity (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Carcinogenicity' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Pharmaceutical (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Pharmaceutical' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Agrochemical (Adjective)
कृषि रसायन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Agrochemical' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile

D. The author contends that 'Microplastics, 'cocktail' of hazardous chemic' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. The focus should be on nature-based solutions," he said.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "The focus should be on nature-based solutions," he said." (Hinglish Arth: ध्यान प्रकृति-आधारित समाधानों पर होना चाहिए," उन्होंने कहा।)

articles.title: In a dilemma: On Sheikh Hasina and India-Bangladesh ties
articles.examRelevance: UPSC, State PSC, SSC & Banking Mains: Deep Analytical Core Summary, Policy Critique, 4 Hinglish Vocab & 2 Analytical Questions
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: India must improve ties with Bangladesh, and protect Hasina

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Bangladesh’s former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina now in exile in India, has set off speculation about her imminent return to Dhaka by submitting an application for a new Bangladeshi passport and national identity card this week. The application, made through the Bangladesh High Commission in Delhi, was dismissed by Prime Minister Tarique Rahman’s Foreign Affairs Adviser Humayun Kabir, who said that the government in Dhaka would not grant a passport to a “terrorist”, and would seek her return via the extradition agreement as a “prisoner transfer process” with India. Ms. Hasina has already announced that she plans to return to Bangladesh in December this year, as she did after her previous stay in India in exile from 1975-1981, after the brutal assassination of her father Sheikh Mujibur Rahman and nearly every other member of her family. However, the situation is considerably different now. This time, Ms. Hasina came to India in 2024 fleeing mobs of protestors that overthrew her government, and has since been convicted by a tribunal for ordering a crackdown on thousands of students, and sentenced to death. In interviews, including to The Hindu , Ms. Hasina says she hopes to return to Bangladesh to argue her case and rebuild her party, the Awami League, but that is hardly likely, given the anger against her amongst the polity, and bipartisan consensus to ban the Awami League from politics. Despite the harsh rhetoric it employs against her, the BNP government is unlikely to wish for her return, as it would have to begin execution proceedings against the 79-year-old former Prime Minister, with international opposition to such a move expected to be voluble. Not doing so would only strengthen its opposition party, the Jamaat-e-Islami, that has accused the Rahman government of soft-pedalling the issue. The government must also worry about possible protests and violence within the country in the event Ms. Hasina returns.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The situation puts the Modi government in a spot. Ever since Ms. Hasina announced plans to return, during a virtual press conference held in Delhi on August 5 this year, Delhi-Dhaka ties have been on a downslide. The government’s decision not to prevent Ms. Hasina from addressing the press, where she used the opportunity to soundly criticise PM Rahman, meant the abrupt cancellation of the Bangladesh PM’s visit. Next month, the Indo-Bangladesh Ganga Water treaty is set to expire, and talks on its extension have also become a casualty. Ms. Hasina has been an honoured guest in India, and the government cannot physically restrain her from taking the flight to Dhaka or travelling to the land border at Petrapole to cross over. Nor can it wash its hands of her situation once she crosses over. New Delhi must redouble its diplomatic efforts on improving bilateral ties while also ensuring Ms. Hasina’s welfare.
